notes.title: Developer Update: Economy and Progression
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43190071/6a16904b29ae7f0771809eac53e62ca7299da396.png"][/img][/p][p]Pilots, thank you for your continued support and patience as we shape the future of War Robots: Frontiers.[/p][p]Over the past few months, we've been carefully planning how new robots and weapons are introduced into the game. We know how important it is to maintain a fair, transparent, and enjoyable experience for all players, especially as the battlefield evolves with new content.[/p][p]With that in mind, we want to take a moment to share how new content will be handled moving forward. Our goal is to keep things clear and consistent for every pilot, whether you're just starting out or deep into your journey.[/p][p]So, here’s what’s changing, and how we plan to introduce new gear in a way that supports a healthy game economy and progression system.[/p][h3]How New Robots and Weapons Will Be Released [/h3][p]Our goal is to give you early access opportunities while ensuring that new content gradually becomes accessible to players through regular gameplay. [/p][list][*][p][b]First, new robots and weapons will debut through limited-time direct sales [/b](including Daily Deals). These offers will be available for a short period and are designed for players who want to get their hands on the latest tech right away.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Next, they’ll be featured in an upcoming Battle Pass or Event Pass[/b]. This gives players another chance to earn them through gameplay while also enjoying seasonal content and rewards.[/p][/*][/list][h3]What’s Coming Next[/h3][p]We know many of you are eager to plan ahead, so here’s a look at the upcoming content schedule and what to expect in the weeks ahead.[/p][list][*][p][b]September 23–30[/b] – The limited-time sale for the new Kumo War Robot is live! This is your first chance to deploy Kumo on the battlefield. But don’t worry if you miss it—[b]Kumo will be making its way into the Battle Pass starting October 14.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]October 14[/b] – [b]Season 3 begins[/b], and with it comes a wave of new content. Throughout the season, we’ll be introducing new spider-type robots and weapons, each bringing unique abilities and playstyles to shake up the meta. We’ll share more details about each addition as they’re released, so stay tuned for regular updates.[/p][/*][*][p]Also launching on October 14, several powerful robots and weapons will be added to the general progression system. This includes the [b]Mesa[/b] and [b]Ceres War Robots[/b], along with the [b]Nucleon[/b] and [b]Apollo[/b] weapons. If you haven’t had a chance to try them yet, you’ll soon be able to unlock them through standard progression.[/p][/*][/list][p]There’s a lot on the horizon, and we’re excited to bring this new content to life as War Robots: Frontiers continues to evolve.[/p][p]Stay tuned—you won’t want to miss what’s coming next![/p]

notes.title: Patch Notes — September 23, 2025
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43190071/bdf2e572e4e8c9ca532137954080b0e35e94921a.png"][/img][/p][p]Attention, Pilots! The following patch will be deployed for War Robots: Frontiers following a short period of maintenance on September 23, 2025.[/p][h2]New Content & Improvements[/h2][h2]New Robot & Weapon: Kumo and the Horde Shotgun[/h2][p]Meet [url="https://youtube.com/shorts/uG4ABKUu7c0?feature=share"]Kumo[/url], the spider-like [b]Defender Robot[/b], armed with its Core Gear [b]WarpArmor[/b]. Equip Kumo with the new Horde Weapon, the [b]Heavy Shotgun[/b]—an energy double-barrel weapon that fires a diverging blast of plasma.[/p][h2]Intel Discount Event [/h2][p]Until September 30, special factory builds now have reduced Intel upgrade costs: [b]Orochi, Ravana, and Fenrir[/b], along with their gear and weapons. Don’t miss out![/p][h2]Last Robot Standing Update[/h2][p][b]Game Modes Last Robot Standing+ [/b]permanently replaces the old Last Robot Standing mode in Ranked Play. The new ruleset includes the following power-ups:[/p][list][*][p][b]Shield[/b]: Provides shield for the whole team that picks it up, regenerating 2000 per second.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Mass Regeneration[/b]: Regenerates 20000 armor of each Module for the whole team that picks it up.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Mass Armor[/b]: Increases damage resistance by 20% for the whole team that picks it up.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Mass Fuel[/b]: Increases restoration speed of fuel by 15% for the whole team that picks it up.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Mass Speed[/b]: Increases acceleration by 30% and speed by 20% for the whole team that picks it up.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Mass Ultimate[/b]: Adds a 150 points charge to Cycle Gear for the whole team that picks it up.[/p][/*][/list][h2]New Animated Skin [/h2][p]The fiery [url="https://youtu.be/To-qbNsYWeY"]Gemwrath[/url] skin is now available.[/p][h2]Pilot Recruitment Program [/h2][p]A referral button has been added to the game. [u][url="https://warrobotsfrontiers.com/en/referral"]Invite your friends[/url][/u] and fight side by side![/p][h2]Gameplay Adjustments[/h2][h3]Balance Changes[/h3][p][b]Warp Scythe Gear Progression[/b][/p][p]Rebalanced stats across levels 1–13 for smoother progression. Damage values and cooldown adjustments ensure a more consistent power curve.[/p][list][*][p]Level 01: Damage 14584 => 14601, Distance 70m => 62m, Cooldown 43s => 43s[/p][/*][*][p]Level 02: Damage 15352 => 16045, Distance 70m => 62m, Cooldown 43s => 43s[/p][/*][*][p]Level 03: Damage 15352 => 16045, Distance 74m => 68m, Cooldown 43s => 43s[/p][/*][*][p]Level 04: Damage 15352 => 17440, Distance 74m => 68m, Cooldown 36s => 43s[/p][/*][*][p]Level 05: Damage 16160 => 17440, Distance 74m => 68m, Cooldown 36s => 36s[/p][/*][*][p]Level 06: Damage 16160 => 17440, Distance 77m => 73m, Cooldown 36s => 36s[/p][/*][*][p]Level 07: Damage 17010 => 18753, Distance 77m => 73m, Cooldown 36s => 36s[/p][/*][*][p]Level 08: Damage 17010 => 18753, Distance 77m => 77m, Cooldown 30s => 36s[/p][/*][*][p]Level 09: Damage 17010 => 18753, Distance 77m => 77m, Cooldown 30s => 30s[/p][/*][*][p]Level 10: Damage 18900 => 19950, Distance 77m => 77m, Cooldown 30s => 30s[/p][/*][*][p]Level 11: Damage 18900 => 19950, Distance 82m => 82m, Cooldown 30s => 30s[/p][/*][*][p]Level 12: Damage 21000 => 21000, Distance 82m => 82m, Cooldown 30s => 30s[/p][/*][*][p]Level 13: Damage 21000 => 21000, Distance 82m => 82m, Cooldown 25s => 25s[/p][/*][/list][h3]General[/h3][list][*][p][b]Customization Unlock [/b]Robot paint and customization options in the Hangar are now locked until [b]level 4[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]Tutorial Adjustments [/b]The starting tutorial is now off by default (can still be launched manually) and Workshop tutorial flicker issues have been resolved.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Ping Wheel [/b]Expanded quick communication with new reactions for faster teamwork.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Leavers Punishment Disabled [/b]The punishment system for leaving battles is turned off for now.[/p][/*][/list][h2]Bug Fixes[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where a squad could disband if the leader left while others were ready.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Cyclops[/b] ability now [/p][/*][/list][p]Need help? Contact our [u][url="https://support.my.games/wrf_int"]Support team[/url][/u] to report any issues you’re facing on the Wild Ten. Join the [u][url="http://link"]official Discord server[/url][/u] to get more of the latest news like this. [/p]

The following patch will be deployed for War Robots: Frontiers following a short period of maintenance on[b] September 9, 2025.[/b][/p][h2]New Content[/h2][list][*][p]Added a new Game Mode: Team Deathmatch +[/p][list][*][p]Team Deathmatch + is available alongside the regular Team Deathmatch Mode.[/p][/*][*][p]Score points by destroying enemy War Robots or by collecting [b]Datacubes[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]The first team to reach the point limit wins.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Added a new Map: [b]Horizon One[/b][/p][/*][*][p]This patch introduces the new [b]Dei Ex Machina Event Pass.[/b][/p][list][*][p]The Event Pass features many rewards including the weapons ‘MLx2’ & ‘Bisector’, and the War Robots ‘Ceres’ & ‘Anansi’.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Added a new Animated Wrap: [url="https://youtu.be/EX0gCtAEQYA"]Drakeplate[/url][/p][/*][*][p]Added a new Cycle Gear: Iron Veil[/p][list][*][p]Reduces all incoming damage by 90% for 3.5s.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Added a new Weapon: Apollo (Light, Electromagnetic, Sniper)[/p][/*][/list][h2]Events[/h2][h3]Intel Upgrade Discount Event[/h3][p]Discounted Upgrades[/p][p][b]War Robots[/b][/p][list][*][p]Bullwark[/p][/*][*][p]Ceres[/p][/*][*][p]Harpy[/p][/*][*][p]Matriarch[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Weapons[/b][/p][list][*][p]Bisector[/p][/*][*][p]Hive (Matriarch)[/p][/*][*][p]Scrubber (Matriarch)[/p][/*][*][p]Railgun[/p][/*][*][p]Thunder[/p][/*][*][p]Trebuchet[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Gear[/b][/p][list][*][p]Blink[/p][/*][*][p]Flashbang[/p][/*][*][p]Fuel Reserve[/p][/*][*][p]Ghost Turret[/p][/*][*][p]Holofield[/p][/*][*][p]Homing Missile[/p][/*][*][p]Nanite Repair[/p][/*][*][p]Reflector[/p][/*][/list][h2]Gameplay Adjustments[/h2][h3]Balance Changes[/h3][p]Alpha[/p][list][*][p]Reduced the radius for ‘Firestorm’ at max. notes.title: Patch Notes — August 26, 2025
notes.notes:
[p]Attention, Pilots! The following patch will be deployed for War Robots: Frontiers following a short period of maintenance on[b] August 26, 2025.[/b][/p][h2]New Content[/h2][h3]New Weapon: Nucleon (Heavy, Autocannon, Electromagnetic, Rare)[/h3][p]Nucleon is available in Daily Deals, with an increased chance of appearing.[/p][h3]Last Robot Standing Update[/h3][p]Last Robot Standing has been temporarily updated with a new ruleset providing the following power-ups:[/p][list][*][p][b]Shield[/b]: Provides Shield.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Mass Regeneration[/b]: Regenerates the Armor of each Module.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Mass Armor[/b]: Increases damage resistance by 20%.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Mass Fuel[/b]: Increases restoration speed of fuel by 20%.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Mass Speed: [/b]Increases acceleration and speed by 20%.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Mass Ultimate: [/b]Adds Cycle Gear Charge.[/p][/*][/list][h2]August Events[/h2][h3]Intel Upgrade Discount Event (August 26–September 9)[/h3][p]Discounted Upgrades[/p][p][b]War Robots[/b][/p][list][*][p]Raven[/p][/*][*][p]Loki[/p][/*][*][p]Phantom[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Weapons[/b][/p][list][*][p]Lighter[/p][/*][*][p]Gozer[/p][/*][*][p]Halo[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Gear[/b][/p][list][*][p]Energy Wall[/p][/*][*][p]Blast Wave[/p][/*][*][p]Fuel Burn[/p][/*][*][p]Recon Mode[/p][/*][*][p]Infinite Ammo[/p][/*][/list][p]Gameplay Adjustments[/p][h3]Armor Values[/h3][p]The armor values of Typhon, Siren, and Bulgasari Modules have been rounded to whole numbers.[/p][h3]Pursuer[/h3][p]Pursuer’s stats have been rebalanced:
[/p][p][b]Chassis[/b][/p][list][*][p]Acceleration has been increased from 43 to 49.[/p][/*][*][p]Maximum speed has been increased from 127 to 131.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Pelvis[/b][/p][list][*][p]Armor has been decreased from 61.300 to 56.000.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Legs[/b][/p][list][*][p]Armor has been decreased from 110.340 to 106.400.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Locust[/h3][p]The weapon ‘Locust’ has been rebalanced:

notes.title: Patch Notes — August 19, 2025
notes.notes:
[p]Attention, Pilots! The following [b]patch [/b]will be deployed for War Robots: Frontiers following a short period of maintenance on[b] August 19, 2025.[/b][/p][h2][color=lightblue]New Content[/color][/h2][list][*][p][b]Limited-Time Event with Returning Map:[/b] Solidus Node: Depot (August 19–26)[/p][/*][/list][h2][color=lightblue]New Charge System for Cycle Gear & Titans[/color][/h2][p]An experimental system has been introduced to help make it clearer for new players what exactly contributes to Cycle Gear and Titan activation. Certain events in-game will contribute to their activation:
[/p][p][b]Offensive Events:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Most damage dealt to a War Robot Module that directly led to its destruction[/p][/*][*][p]Destroying a War Robot[/p][/*][*][p]Destroying a Titan[/p][/*][*][p]Assists[/p][/*][*][p]Shield Damage dealt[/p][/*][*][p]Armor Damage dealt
[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Tactical Events:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Damage absorbed[/p][/*][*][p]Survival time[/p][/*][*][p]Picking up a Power-Up[/p][/*][*][p]Healing allies*[/p][/*][*][p]Deactivating, capturing, and holding Beacons and Warp Probes[/p][/*][*][p]Contesting Beacons and Warp Probes[/p][/*][/list][p]Some Events may indeed cause noticeable spikes in activations. We are collecting statistics and making adjustments as quickly as possible, both to Events and the balance of Weapons and Gear, to address new and older content alike.
[/p][p]A balanced gameplay experience is just as crucial to us as it is to you. Your constructive feedback is extremely valuable to us, so let us know what you think of the new systems and please continue sharing your thoughts via the feedback channel on Discord![/p][p][/p][h2][color=lightblue]Gameplay Adjustments[/color][/h2][list][*][p]Added an ‘Apply’ button when editing a War Robot’s Paint.[/p][/*][*][p]Players can now earn additional Impact Points for healing allies.[/p][/*][/list][h2][color=lightblue]Technical Adjustments[/color][/h2][list][*][p]Improved performance for the PS5 client.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed various crashes for the PS5 client.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved performance in matches on all platforms.[/p][/*][/list][h2][color=lightblue]Bug Fixes[/color][/h2][list][*][p][b]Gear: [/b]Fixed a bug where Gamma Beam Cycle Gear was not available in the Intel Discount event.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Gear:[/b] Fixed a bug where Scorpion’s Whiplash (Core Gear) would not enter its cooldown period when using it on the Firing Range.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Jobs:[/b] Fixed a bug where rewards for ‘The Resurgence’, ‘Fortuitous Circumstance’, and ‘Let it Bloom’ would not be credited to the player after the Job requirements had been adjusted after the previous hotfix/patch.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Maps:[/b] Fixed a bug where players could get stuck in the corner of the elevator on the Solidus Node: Depot map.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Maps:[/b] Fixed a bug where players could shoot through the walls on the Solidus Node: Depot map.[/p][/*][*][p][b]War Robots:[/b] Fixed a bug where invalid War Robots would be shown in the selection when editing a Drop Team.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]Follow the game on [url="https://twitter.com/WRFrontiers"]X[/url] and [url="https://www.facebook.com/wrfrontiers"]Facebook[/url] and join the [url="https://warrobotsfrontiers.com/l/discord"]official Discord server[/url] to get all the latest hotfix info.[/p][p]Need help? notes.title: Patch Notes — August 12, 2025
notes.notes:
[p]Attention, Pilots! The following [b]patch [/b]will be deployed for War Robots: Frontiers following a short period of maintenance on[b] August 12, 2025.[/b][/p][h2]New Content[/h2][p][b]Anansi (War Robot)[/b][/p][p]Seize the high ground with [b]Anansi[/b], a Tactician that boasts high maneuverability thanks to its spider-like properties. Activate its [b]Camouflage Web (Core Gear)[/b] to render allies within the area invisible to foes.[/p][p][b]Carmen Ruiz (Legendary Pilot)[/b][/p][p]Hand the controls over to [b]Carmen[/b], a confident Pilot with undeniable skills. Her [b]Ace Talent[/b], [b]Press The Attack, [/b]boosts rate of fire when damaging an enemy with your Gear.[/p][p][b]MLx2 (Weapon)[/b][/p][p]Bring the boom to battle with the new [b]MLx2 [/b]Heavy Rocket Launcher. Use it to lock onto targets and launch a hail of homing missiles.[/p][p][b]Scrubber (Titan Weapon)[/b][/p][p]Load up your Matriarch with new weapons designed to erase the enemy. [/p][p][b]Suppressor (Supply Gear)[/b][/p][p]Equip your Defender War Robots with a sticky grenade that weakens nearby foes. [/p][p][b]Spirit Core (Animated Wrap)[/b][/p][p]Show off your fighting spirit with this dynamic style[b].[/b][/p][h2]August Events[/h2][h3]Intel Upgrade Discount Event (August 12-26)[/h3][p]Discounted Upgrades[/p][p][b]War Robots[/b][/p][list][*][p]Tyr[/p][/*][*][p]Fury[/p][/*][*][p]Scorpion[/p][/*][*][p]Grim[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Weapons[/b][/p][list][*][p]Pulsar[/p][/*][*][p]Tusk[/p][/*][*][p]Jigsaw[/p][/*][*][p]Katzbalger[/p][/*][*][p]Vortex[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Gear[/b][/p][list][*][p]Repulsor (Supply Gear)[/p][/*][*][p]Blink (Supply Gear)[/p][/*][*][p]Ghost Turret (Supply Gear)[/p][/*][*][p]Homing Missile (Cycle Gear)[/p][/*][*][p]Gamma Beam (Cycle Gear)[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Abilities[/b][/p][list][*][p]Ripper (Grim)[/p][/*][*][p]Warp Scythe (Grim)[/p][/*][*][p]Snare (Grim)[/p][/*][/list][h2]Technical Adjustments[/h2][list][*][p]US servers have been split into three separate servers:[/p][list][*][p]US East[/p][/*][*][p]US Central[/p][/*][*][p]US West[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Improved stability for the PS5 client.[/p][/*][/list][h2]Gameplay Adjustments[/h2][h3]Leaver Penalty[/h3][p]To reduce the number of players who leave matches prematurely, match rewards will no longer be distributed to players who leave a match before a certain point.[/p][h3]Chassis Upgrades[/h3][p]The upgrade system for all War Robot Chassis in the game, including Titans, has been reworked and rebalanced.[/p][p]Previously, some Chassis only upgraded Acceleration, while others only upgraded Max Speed. Now all Chassis receive upgrades to both stats.[/p][p]Most Chassis retain the same stats as before at level 5, except for those with very low Acceleration. The new minimum Acceleration in the game is now set to 30, and has been assigned to Bulwark ( previously 27). Other low-Acceleration Chassis received similar or slightly smaller increases depending on their original values.

The Armor gained per level has been significantly increased, and total Armor at max level has also been slightly raised.[/p][h3]Workshop[/h3][list][*][p]The Info Panel in the Workshop for both War Robots and Titans has been updated.[/p][list][*][p]The stats now update automatically when switching between Modules.[/p][/*][*][p]Differences between changes are now visually highlighted.[/p][/*][*][p]The layout has been improved for better readability.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Factory Wraps can now be customized with customization options such as Decals, Materials, Stickers, and Weathering.[/p][list][*][p]A Revert function has also been implemented for Factory Wraps, restoring the Wrap to its factory default state.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]The maximum Sticker size has been increased.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Crews[/h3][list][*][p]Players can now request to join Crews via their Friend List.[/p][/*][*][p]Switching to other screens while the status of a Crew is set to ‘Ready’ may not allow the players to join the match. To prevent this, players in a Crew who set their status to ‘Ready’ will now have their UI disabled. Players can set their status back to ‘Not Ready’ by pressing the ‘Play’ button again.[/p][/*][/list][h2]Balance Changes[/h2][h3]Fuel Burn (Supply Gear)[/h3][list][*][p]Fuel Burn has had its mechanics slightly reworked.[/p][/*][*][p]After using Fuel Burn, Fuel Regeneration is now blocked for 5 seconds.[/p][/*][*][p]Upgrading Fuel Burn no longer increases its range. The range is now set to 375 meters across all levels.[/p][/*][*][p]Ability Charges have been reduced from 6 to 4.[/p][/*][/list][h2]Bug Fixes[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed a bug where Ceres could not jump as high as intended.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the arrow icons to scroll through War Robot Builds in the Workshop would not display when there are 7 Builds.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where, after fully unlocking a War Robot via progression tracking, the system would not automatically track the next War Robot to unlock.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the ‘Track Item Unlock’ button was displayed for Titans in the Rewards track.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where players were unable to assign a newly created Robot Build to the Hangar.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the spawn animations would occasionally not play correctly.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where wrong values were shown for ‘Sprint Reactor’. The values now correctly show the speed in km/h.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]Follow the game on [url="https://twitter.com/WRFrontiers"]X[/url] and [url="https://www.facebook.com/wrfrontiers"]Facebook[/url] and join the [url="https://warrobotsfrontiers.com/l/discord"]official Discord server[/url] to get all the latest hotfix info.[/p][p]Need help? Contact our [url="https://support.my.games/wrf_int"]Support team[/url] to report any issues you’re facing on the Wild Ten.[/p]

notes.notes: [p]Time to evolve and adapt, Pilots! The following patch will be deployed for War Robots: Frontiers following a short period of maintenance on[b] July 29, 2025. [/b]This patch will introduce the Spark of Ingenuity Battle Pass to Season 2: Power Surge, alongside new content to unlock.[/p][h1][color=lightblue]New Content[/color][/h1][h2][color=lightblue]Spark of Ingenuity Battle Pass[/color][/h2][p]The[b] Spark of Ingenuity Battle Pass [/b]is your way of evolving and adapting to new battles on the Wild Ten. Play to earn XP and Battle Tokens, level up your Pass, and exchange your Battle Tokens for new electrifying content.[/p][list][*][p]New War Robot: [b]Mesa [/b](Defender) with Harmonizer (Core Gear) added.[/p][/*][*][p]New Weapon: [b]Locust [/b](Light | Kinetic | Shotgun) added.[/p][/*][*][p]New Supply Gear: [b]Ammo Fabricator[/b] added.[/p][/*][*][p]New [b]cosmetic options[/b] added.[/p][/*][/list][p]Discover and unlock [b]40+ rewards[/b] throughout the rest of Season 2: Power Surge![/p][h2][color=lightblue]New Cosmetics[/color][/h2][list][*][p][b]Two new Animated Wraps[/b] have been added to the Store.[/p][/*][/list][h2][color=lightblue]Intel Discount Event (July 29–August 26)[/color][/h2][p]Need a boost? [b]Returning players [/b]can battle daily for up to seven days, and[b] new players [/b]can level up to unlock bonus Intel, a crucial resource used to upgrade your battle Builds. Enjoy Intel upgrade discounts on the following items:[/p][h3][color=lightblue]War Robots[/color][/h3][list][*][p]Siren[/p][/*][*][p]Cyclops[/p][/*][*][p]Pursuer[/p][/*][/list][h3][color=lightblue]Weapons[/color][/h3][list][*][p]Trident[/p][/*][*][p]Railgun[/p][/*][*][p]Gemini[/p][/*][*][p]Scatter[/p][/*][/list][h3][color=lightblue]Gear[/color][/h3][list][*][p]Supply Gear: Energy Wall[/p][/*][*][p]Cycle Gear: Homing Missile[/p][/*][*][p]Cycle Gear: Umbrella[/p][/*][*][p]Supply Gear: Blink[/p][/*][*][p]Cycle Gear: Recon Mode[/p][/*][/list][h2][color=lightblue]Battle Pass Adjustments[/color][/h2][list][*][p]Players working through the Free Battle Pass can now earn enough Tokens to access all 4 Shipments of the Spark of Ingenuity Battle Pass, with some items still locked for Battle Pass Gold players.[/p][/*][/list][h2][color=lightblue]Gameplay Adjustments[/color][/h2][h3][color=lightblue]Match Making[/color][/h3][list][*][p]Matchmaking now prioritizes Crews of 4 or more to only be able to play with other Crews of the same size. This change is to protect solo-queue players from playing against full organised groups, and allows organised groups to match together easier.[/p][/*][*][p]Maximum matchmaking time for Crews consisting of 4 or more players has been changed to 5 minutes.[/p][/*][/list][h3][color=lightblue]Gear[/color][/h3][list][*][p]Players can now see the trajectory of Ghost Turret (Supply Gear) when activating it.[/p][/*][/list][h3][color=lightblue]Player Progression[/color][/h3][list][*][p]Player progression has been updated. Blueprints for Scorpion (War Robot), Tusk (Weapon), and Repulsor (Supply Gear) are now available through player progression.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a widget in the ‘Play’ screen that shows which War Robots can be unlocked through progression.[/p][/*][*][p]Added additional Keybindings for the Workshop.[/p][list][*][p]Customize: LMB[/p][/*][*][p]Options: RMB[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h3][color=lightblue]Sound Effects (SFX)[/color][/h3][list][*][p]Updated SFX when walking. SFX now changes depending on the surface a player is moving on.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved environmental sounds on the maps Terminus, Catalyst, Spectrum, and Tutorial.[/p][/*][*][p]Added new SFX when capturing Warp Beacons.[/p][/*][/list][h3][color=lightblue]User Interface (UI)[/color][/h3][list][*][p]When editing a War Robot in the Workshop, Blueprints are no longer displayed as the first item.[/p][/*][*][p]The ‘Battle Results’ screen has been redesigned and now highlights level progression.[/p][/*][*][p]A player’s League is now displayed on the matchmaking screen.[/p][/*][*][p]UI in the Crew Tab has been updated.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a visible indicator on the Crusher button on the map ‘Fissure’.[/p][/*][*][p]Premium purchase animations and purchase animations in the Store can now be skipped.[/p][/*][/list][h3][color=lightblue]Visual Effects (VFX)[/color][/h3][list][*][p]Adjusted VFX for the following Core Gear and Cycle Gear:[/p][list][*][p]Death Ray (Cyclops): Ally VFX is now yellow.[/p][/*][*][p]Infinite Ammo (Cycle Gear): VFX is now purple.[/p][/*][*][p]Warp Reload (Fury): VFX is now purple.[/p][/*][*][p]Wrath (Ares): Enemy VFX is now red.[/p][/*][*][p]Zealot (Purifier): notes.title: Hotfix Patch Notes — July 15, 2025
notes.notes: [p]Attention, Pilots! The following hotfix will be deployed for War Robots: Frontiers following a short period of maintenance on[b] July 15, 2025.[/b][/p][h2]New Content[/h2][h3]New War Robot and Weapon[/h3][p]A new unannounced War Robot and Weapon have been added to the game as part of the Store and Daily Deals. [/p][p]More details regarding this War Robot will be revealed in a separate publication on July 15, 2025![/p][h3]New Titan Weapon (Bayonet)[/h3][p][b]Event Duration:[/b] July 15 - July 22[/p][list][*][p]Alpha now supports a second weapon: Bayonet[/p][/*][*][p]Bayonet is now available in Slot 5 and 6 of Daily Deals with a higher drop change during the event.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Intel Discount Event[/h3][p][b]Event Duration:[/b] July 15 - July 29[/p][p]Reduced the intel upgrade cost based on rarities for specified War Robots and Titans (including Modules, Gear and Weapons) for the duration of this event.[/p][list][*][p][b]War Robots:[/b] Lancelot, Ares, Varangian, Ravana, Typhon[/p][/*][*][p][b]Titans: [/b]Alpha[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Note:[/b] As the Alpha Weapon “Bayonet” is newly added to the game, it will not be included as part of this event.[/p][p]More details on reductions will be shared in a separate publication on July 15, 2025.[/p][h3]Daily Deal Bonus Feature[/h3][p]We have added a loyalty feature to the Daily Deals section. When purchasing Salvage from Daily Deals, players can now receive additional rewards for hitting Milestones on total amounts of purchased Salvage. These rewards include Intel and customization options, including a new customization type: Animated Wraps.[/p][p]More details on exact rewards and milestones will be shared in a separate publication on July 15, 2025.[/p][h3]Daily Deal Freeze Feature[/h3][p]We have added the option to freeze Daily Deals. This option lets you select an item in Daily Deals and prevent it from rotating out, allowing you to save an item you’re interested in until you’re ready to buy it.[/p][list][*][p]You can only freeze one item at a time.[/p][/*][*][p]If you decide you do not want the item you have frozen, you can remove your freeze and add it to another item that you desire.[/p][/*][*][p]The freeze will be lifted on the reset timer of Daily Deals and if you refresh your Daily Deals manually. If you refresh your Daily Deals manually, remember to reapply your Freeze before refreshing again.[/p][/*][/list][p]With the introduction of the Freeze Feature and Bonus Feature for Daily Deals, the “Buy All” button price (WarpReals) has been increased. The price will also increase dynamically after the second purchase. The dynamic pricing resets to the starting value each day.[/p][h3]Animated Wraps[/h3][p]A new type of customization has been added to the game[b]: Animated Wraps[/b]. In this update, two Animated Wraps have been added to the game:[/p][list][*][p]Hyperpop - Available through Daily Deal Bonus Reward milestones.[/p][/*][*][p]Pyroclast - Available through WarpReal bundles in the Store.[/p][/*][/list][p]You can equip your Animated Wrap similar to Factory Wraps. Select the War Robot you would like to Paint and then equip your newly found Animated Wrap from the Wraps interface.[/p][h2]Gameplay Adjustments[/h2][list][*][p]The minimap now shows the exact location of Power Ups, even if they are still on cooldown.[/p][/*][/list][h2]Balancing Adjustments[/h2][h3]Shoulder Modules[/h3][p]We have adjusted the upgrade values for Shoulders based on War Robot Class.[/p][list][*][p][b]Assault: [/b][/p][list][*][p]Shield Cooldown Reduction (+4% compared to previous values at level 13)[/p][/*][*][p]Additional Armor (+6% compared to previous values at level 13)[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Tactician:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Shield Cooldown Reduction (+2% compared to previous values at level 13)[/p][/*][*][p]Shield Regeneration Rate (+15% compared to previous values at level 13)[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Defender:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Shield Cooldown Reduction (+2% compared to previous values at level 13)[/p][/*][*][p]Additional Armor (+12% compared to previous values at level 13)[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Flanker:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Additional Armor (+8% compared to previous values at level 13)[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][url="https://warrobotsfrontiers.com/news/246" style="button"]A full breakdown of each stat for each War Robot can be found in the article here[/url][/p][h3]War Robots[/h3][p][b]Volta:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Increased Torso Armor from 181,000 to 200,000[/p][/*][*][p]Increases Chassis Armor from 105,000 to 155,000[/p][/*][*][p]Increased Shield Cooldown Reduction on Shoulder Modules from 0.2s to 0.28s.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased Cascade’s Projectile Speed from 45,000 to 52,000.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased Tesla Coil damage from 13,500 to 22,000.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased Tesla Coil duration from 13s to 19s.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced Galvanic Screen cooldown from 28s to 25s.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Weapons[/h3][p][b]Halo:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Increased time to reload from 1.55s to 1.7s.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Shocktrain:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Increased time to reload from 3.6s to 4.1s[/p][/*][*][p]Decreased effective Chain Range from 150m to notes.title: Season 2: Power Surge | Patch Notes — June 17, 2025
notes.notes: [p]Incoming, Pilots! A new major update will be deployed for War Robots: Frontiers following a short period of maintenance on[b] June 17, 2025. [/b]This update will introduce Season 2: Power Surge, and a host of new content and quality-of-life updates.[/p][h1]New Content[/h1][h2]Season 2: Power Surge[/h2][p]The battle for Terminus continues. Despite the ongoing blockade, Pilots have adapted and found new sources of supplies. Some have learned to scavenge and build, while others have turned to smuggling. But just as life on Tortuga seems to be getting back on track, the Warp network collapses, paralyzing all activities in the Wild Ten. With everything at stake, it’s up to the Pilots to fix what's broken.[/p][h2]War Robots: Loki & Mesa[/h2][list][*][p][b]Loki (Unlockable via the Scavenger’s Hunt Battle Pass & Daily Deals):[/b] Trickster by name, trickster by nature. Loki's ability to use holographic projections makes it an excellent infiltrator and scout. Its armor is strong for its class, and its anti-shield firepower means it can easily take on flankers, though it should avoid encounters with heavier foes. Add Loki to your Drop Team and see what this stealthy War Robot can do. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Mesa (Unlockable via the Spark of Ingenuity Battle Pass & Daily Deals from July 29):[/b] Defend ‘til the end with Mesa, a strong defender with amazing ally-protecting abilities. Deploy barriers to shield Mesa and its teammates from projectiles, or unleash a biotech drone that follows alongside it, buffing allies and weakening enemies in the area. [/p][/*][/list][h2]Titan: Volta[/h2][list][*][p][b]Volta (Unlockable via account progression at Level 50):[/b] Turn up the voltage. This live wire Titan is the first quadruped to be built on Tortuga, and it’s as aggressive as it is electrifying. With its ability to double jump and hover, these new traversal capabilities are sure to set Volta apart from other Titans on the battlefield. Activate its electric weapon, generate a moving barrier, or block projectiles and deal damage to enemies foolish enough to pass through.[/p][/*][/list][h2]Game Mode: Spearhead[/h2][p]Powerslide into a brand-new game mode: [b]Spearhead[/b]. [/p][p]Two teams fight over randomly spawning Warp Probes to stabilize Warp in the region. Locate and capture them first to earn Points! Hit the Points cap, stay ahead, or eliminate all enemies to win.[/p][h2]Battle Pass: Scavenger’s Haul[/h2][p]Whether you’re on the Free track or want to upgrade your Battle Pass to earn more rewards, dozens of adrenaline-pumping rewards are waiting to be unlocked:[/p][list][*][p]Loki Modules[/p][/*][*][p]Halo Weapons[/p][/*][*][p]Recon Mode (Cycle Gear)[/p][/*][*][p]Fuel Burn (Supply Gear)[/p][/*][*][p]5 Stickers[/p][/*][*][p]5 Paints[/p][/*][*][p]2 Decals[/p][/*][*][p]2 Wear and Tears[/p][/*][*][p]1 Common Pilot[/p][/*][*][p]Intel, Credits & Salvage[/p][/*][/list][p]In Season 1: Blockade, new Shipments for the Battle Pass were added regularly, unlocking access to new pages of rewards as they arrived. Starting with Season 2: Power Surge, [b]all Battle Pass rewards will be available to unlock from day one[/b]. Earn those Battle Tokens to be among the first Pilots to construct Loki![/p][p]Additionally, [b]Intel [/b]can now be obtained from the Battle Pass for free. You can earn up to 200 Intel through free progression, a [url="https://warrobotsfrontiers.com/news/158"]crucial resource[/url] used to upgrade your best Builds.[/p][p]We’ve also rebalanced the Battle Pass and [b]Free progression[/b] to give you even more Credits, Salvage, and Intel throughout the Pass. You can still complete at least one full Shipment (plus change) without upgrading your Pass, but Free progression will not award enough Battle Tokens to obtain the Torso or Chassis Modules on Shipment 2 and beyond. However, keep an eye on Daily Deals, and you can spend your Credits on the Modules and Weapons you seek![/p][p]A new Battle Pass will launch on July 29: [b]Spark of Ingenuity[/b]. Be sure to collect all your rewards in Scavenger’s Haul before this date![/p][h2]Battle Pass Content Available in Daily Deals[/h2][p][b]War Robots and Weapons will now launch in Daily Deals[/b] at the same time they’re available in the Battle Pass! This change is designed to give Pilots more options for unlocking battle gear, without having to spend WarpReals.[/p][p]With the launch of Season 2: Power Surge, [b]Loki Modules and the Halo Weapon[/b] are now available in Daily Deals, along with [b]Scorpion Modules and the Tusk Weapon[/b] from Season 1: Blockade.[/p][h2]Hero Pilot: Sora Sing[/h2][p]Unleash the sparky [b]Sora Sing (available in the Store)[/b] as your War Robot’s new Pilot. This infamous femme fatale has found herself with a public persona she may not deserve, taking the fall for war crimes which saw her stripped of her citizenship, and expatriated to the Wild Ten—the only place that would take her. [/p][p]While her fellow Pilots may not trust her just yet, her talents hit all the high notes, and her ability to reload faster and boost damage (among others) make her a more than capable Pilot. notes.title: Upcoming Changes to the Battle Pass, Progression & Daily Deals
notes.notes:
[url=https://warrobotsfrontiers.com/news/210]Season 2: Power Surge[/url] is set to bring a cargo load of new improvements and changes to War Robots: Frontiers. Alongside a fresh delivery of seasonal content and rewards, we’ve also been working on [b]important changes[/b] to the Battle Pass, account progression, and what’s available in Daily Deals to expand construction and customization possibilities for all players. 

Read on to learn more, including details about [b]upcoming events[/b] in War Robots: Frontiers!
[h2]Battle Pass: Shipment Unlock Timer Removed[/h2]
In Season 1: Blockade, new Shipments for the Battle Pass were added on a regular basis, unlocking access to new pages of rewards throughout the duration of the Battle Pass. Starting with Season 2: Power Surge and the Scavenger’s Haul Battle Pass on June 17, [b]all Battle Pass rewards will be available to unlock from day one[/b]. Earn those Battle Tokens to be among the first Pilots to construct Loki!
[h2]Battle Pass Rewards: Intel Added to Free Progression[/h2]
[b]Intel [/b]can now be obtained from the Battle Pass for free. Starting with the Scavenger’s Haul Battle Pass (launching June 17), you’ll be able to earn up to 200 Intel through free progression, a [url=https://warrobotsfrontiers.com/news/158]crucial resource[/url] used to upgrade your best Builds.
[previewyoutube=fO_xcoY9QZs;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]Battle Pass Content Coming to Daily Deals on Day One[/h2]
[b]War Robots and Weapons will launch in Daily Deals[/b] at the same time they’re available in the Battle Pass! This change is designed to give Pilots more options for unlocking battle gear, without having to spend WarpReals.

Season 2: Power Surge will introduce [b]Loki Modules and the Halo Weapon[/b] to Daily Deals at the beginning of the Season, with [b]Scorpion Modules and the Tusk Weapon[/b] from Season 1: Blockade also joining the Daily Deals roster.

We’ve also rebalanced the Battle Pass and [b]Free progression[/b] to give you even more Credits, Salvage, and Intel throughout the Pass. You can still complete at least one full Shipment (plus change) without upgrading your Pass, but Free progression will not award enough Battle Tokens to obtain the Torso or Chassis Modules on Shipment 2 and beyond. However, keep an eye on Daily Deals, and you can spend your Credits on the Modules and Weapons you seek!
[h2]Daily Deals Refresh Changes[/h2]
If you’re hunting for that perfect Module or Weapon, [b]your first Daily Refresh will now cost 700 Credits instead of WarpReals[/b]. This is designed to increase your chances of getting the Daily Deal you want, without spending WarpReals. You should be able to earn this amount of Credits from a single Daily Job, so happy hunting [u]and [/u]shopping, Pilots!

Further Daily Refreshes beyond your first will still cost WarpReals, with more Refreshes available at rising increments (starting at 15 WarpReals for your first, and increasing by 10 each time up to a maximum of 45 WarpReals). 
[previewyoutube=rbw2_88PPlo;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]Daily Deals Chances[/h2]
You can check a new chance table on Daily Deals to view your percentage chance of seeing certain items based on their rarity. This is designed to increase transparency on the rewards available and set expectations on what you might find there.
[previewyoutube=D0wIpvjvvkw;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]Account Progression: New Account Levels & Rewards[/h2]
[b]More Account Levels and rewards[/b] have been added! Players can now progress to Level 95 (up from Level 80). The new progression rewards include a [b]Cyclops War Robot (Factory Build)[/b], with new Modules available at every third Level (Levels 83, 86, 89, 92, 95). 30 Intel will be awarded at every other Level (e.g. Levels 81, 82, 84, etc.)

Even [b]more Account Levels and progression rewards (including Scorpion Modules)[/b] will be added alongside the Spark of Ingenuity Battle Pass, launching July 29.
[previewyoutube=EFzvWm3j_hY;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]Season 2: Upcoming Events[/h2]
Plug into Season 2: Power Surge when it launches on June 17 to enjoy celebratory events:
[list][*][b]Twitch Drops:[/b] Tune in to War Robots: Frontiers Content Creators on Twitch to earn rewards![/*][*][b]Intel Catch-up:[/b] A special event for returning and new players to help get your Builds up to scratch.[/*][*][b]Pilot XP Event:[/b] Put your Pilots through a rigorous boot camp to bring out their best in battle.[/*][*][b]New Credit Offers[/b]: Idy Demerost (Hero Pilot) and Fury (War Robot) with Pulsar Weapons will be available to buy for Credits, replacing Kate Sinclair (Hero Pilot) and Griffin (War Robot).[/*][*][b]New Titan Weapon Coming to Daily Deals:[/b] Jigsaw, a new Titan Weapon built for Grim, will be available via Daily Deals for a limited time (stay tuned for more details).[/*][/list]
Keep your eyes on your comms, Pilots!

notes.title: Season 2: Power Surge – Electrifying New Update Lands June 17!
notes.notes:
Prepare for the Power Surge when Season 2 launches on [b]June 17[/b]! Soup up new War Robots [b]Loki [/b]and [b]Mesa[/b], charge into battle in the new [b]Spearhead [/b]game mode, boost your arsenal with the [b]Scavenger’s Haul Battle Pass,[/b] take control of the new Titan [b]Volta[/b], and much more.

[previewyoutube=nJqvs_fl1kM;full][/previewyoutube]

The battle for Terminus continues. Despite the ongoing blockade, Pilots have adapted and found new sources of supplies. Some have learned to scavenge and build, while others turned to smuggling. But just as life on Tortuga seems to be getting back on track, the Warp network collapses, paralyzing all activities in the Wild Ten. With everything at stake, it’s up to the Pilots to fix what's broken. 
[h2]Power Up With A New Playtest[/h2]
Eager to try out the new content below before the launch of Season 2? Join our [b]upcoming playtest from May 15–16[/b] (Steam and MY.GAMES Launcher only). Keep your eyes peeled for more information coming soon!
[h2]Scavenger’s Haul Battle Pass[/h2]
Boost your [b]Scavenger’s Haul Battle Pass [/b][b](arriving June 17) [/b]to unlock dozens of adrenaline-pumping rewards, including exclusive [b]cosmetics[/b], [b]battle gear[/b], and a new War Robot: [b]Loki[/b]!

That’s not all. On [b]July 29,[/b] unlock the [b]Spark Of Ingenuity Battle Pass,[/b] containing even more incredible rewards, including another [b]new War Robot: Mesa! [/b]
[h2]New Titan: Volta [/h2]
Turn up the voltage with a brand new Titan: [b]Volta[/b]. This live wire Titan is the first quadruped to be built on Tortuga, and it’s as aggressive as it is electrifying. With its ability to double jump and hover, these new traversal capabilities are sure to set Volta apart from other Titans on the battlefield. 

Activate its electric weapon, generate a moving barrier, or block projectiles and deal damage to enemies foolish enough to pass through.

[b][img]https://static-eu.prod-my.games/chronos-public-eu-wrf-prod/site/2025/05/210-PowerSurgeAnnounce/1.png[/img][/b]
[h2]Map Updates: Spectrum & Fissure[/h2]
Much has happened in the Wild Ten since the beginning of the blockade. Freecon rebuilt the Spectrum Research Facility, seemingly preparing for the next stage of their mysterious experiment, and the Fissure mining site was taken over by Warp anomalies. Despite that, mining operations here are still ongoing. 

Have any of these events caused the Warp blackout? At this point, we can only speculate.

What we know for sure is that both the [b]Spectrum and Fissure maps[/b] received a massive facelift, along with better weather setups and improved terrain readability.
[h2]New Game Mode: Spearhead[/h2]
Powerslide into a brand-new game mode: [b]Spearhead[/b]. 

Two teams fight over randomly spawning Warp Probes to stabilize Warp in the region. Locate and capture them first to earn Points! Hit the Points cap, stay ahead, or eliminate all enemies to win. 

[b][img]https://static-eu.prod-my.games/chronos-public-eu-wrf-prod/site/2025/05/210-PowerSurgeAnnounce/2.png[/img][/b]
[h2]New War Robots: Loki & Mesa [/h2][h3]Loki[/h3]
Trickster by name, trickster by nature. [b]Loki[/b]'s ability to use holographic projections makes it an excellent infiltrator and scout. Its armor is strong for its class, and its anti-shield firepower means it can easily take on flankers, though it should avoid encounters with heavier foes. Add Loki to your Drop Team and see what this stealthy War Robot can do. 

Unlock Loki through the[b] Scavenger’s Haul Battle Pass [/b][b](coming June 17).[/b]

[b][img]https://static-eu.prod-my.games/chronos-public-eu-wrf-prod/site/2025/05/210-PowerSurgeAnnounce/3.png[/img][/b]
[h3]Mesa[/h3]
Defend ‘til the end with [b]Mesa[/b], a strong defender with amazing ally-protecting abilities. Deploy barriers to shield Mesa and its teammates from projectiles, or unleash a biotech drone that follows alongside it, buffing allies and weakening enemies in the area. 

Make Mesa your mate later in Season 2 through the[b] Spark Of Ingenuity Battle Pass (coming July 22). [/b]
[h2]New Hero Pilot: Sora Sing[/h2]
Unleash the sparky [b]Sora Sing[/b] as your War Robot’s new Pilot. This infamous femme fatale has found herself with a public persona she may not deserve, taking the fall for war crimes which saw her stripped of her citizenship, and expatriated to the Wild Ten—the only place that would take her. 

While her fellow Pilots may not trust her just yet, her talents hit all the high notes, and her ability to reload faster and boost damage (among others) make her a more than capable Pilot. Remember, it’s not over until the Sora Sings…

[b]Sora Sing will be available in the Store.[/b]
[h2]Updated Leagues Rewards System[/h2]
In a recent [url=https://warrobotsfrontiers.com/news/190]Dev Diary,[/url] we announced that rewards from previous League ranks would also be earnable. For example, if you reach Gold in Milestone 1, you will receive Bronze, Silver, and Gold rewards. However, if you reach Diamond in Milestone 2, you will receive only the Milestone 2 rewards for Bronze, Silver, Gold, Platinum, Emerald, and Diamond.

We are not changing the way that Milestone rewards work in Season 2, meaning that if a player joins during Milestone 2, they cannot obtain the Milestone 1 rewards 

The total number of leagues and requirement points will stay the same, but players will drop Leagues at the beginning of Season 2. For example, if you land in Silver at the end of Season 1, you will begin in Bronze in Season 2.

For more information on recently implemented changes and exciting upcoming events, keep an eye out for [b]a new Q&A video,[/b] info on an [b]upcoming Playtest, [/b]and a[b] Leagues Event.[/b]

notes.title: Hotfix Patch Notes — April 29, 2025
notes.notes:
Watch those shields, Pilots! The following hotfix will be deployed for War Robots: Frontiers following a short period of maintenance on[b] April 29, 2025.[/b]

The majority of these changes were tested by the War Robots: Frontiers community in our recent Balancing Playtest. Thank you to all the Pilots who participated and helped us finetune these improvements and rebalancing updates! For more detailed information about the reasoning and feedback that led to these changes, check out the [url=https://warrobotsfrontiers.com/news/198]Balancing Playtest[/url] article.
[h2]Gameplay Adjustments[/h2][h3]Battle[/h3]
We received very positive feedback regarding the adjustments to Spawn Points and the Respawn buff, and will be implementing them in this update:
[list][*]Spawn Points no longer provide a damage buff, only damage resistance.[/*][*][b]Last Robot Standing:[/b] Changed Spawn Points and removed the timer from them.[/*][/list][h3]Store[/h3][list][*]Improved the visibility of the end timer for the Battle Pass.[/*][*]“Customization” is now displayed as the seventh category in the Store.[/*][*]The Store will no longer automatically cycle through categories if a player manually switches between offers.[/*][/list][h2]Balance Adjustments[/h2][h3]Weapons[/h3][list][*][b]Incinerator:[/b] We are applying our changes from the recent [url=https://warrobotsfrontiers.com/news/198]Balancing Playtest[/url]. Reworked its damage over time (DoT) effect – it now stacks when using multiple Weapons of this type, and scales with the Weapon’s base damage, improving as the Weapon is upgraded.[list][*]Armor DoT: 7,000 per second by each Weapon at max Lvl (previously 18,000)[/*][*]Shield DoT: 1,000 (previously 3,000)[/*][/list][/*][*][b][b]Lighter: [/b][/b]We are applying our changes from the recent [url=https://warrobotsfrontiers.com/news/198]Balancing Playtest[/url]. Redistributed area of effect (AoE) and direct damage.[list][*]Direct Damage To Shields: 465 (previously 420)[/*][*]Direct Damage To Armor: 515 (previously 445)[/*][*]AoE Damage To Shields: 90 (previously 135)[/*][*]AoE Damage To Armor: 200 (previously 270)[/*][*]AoE Radius: Reduced by 28.6%[/*][/list][/*][*][b]Vortex: [/b]We are applying the change from the recent [url=https://warrobotsfrontiers.com/news/198]Balancing Playtest[/url]. Projectiles now travel directly to the target (no longer predictive).[/*][*][b]Tusk: [/b]These changes were not tested in our most recent [url=https://warrobotsfrontiers.com/news/198]Balancing Playtest[/url], however, they have been carefully planned, and we are confident in their necessity based on the initial feedback regarding Tusk.[list][*]Rebalanced various values:[list][*]Initial Projectile Speed: 12,000 (previously 38,000)[/*][*]Initial Spread X: 3 (previously 5)[/*][*]Initial Spread Y: 5 (previously 8)[/*][*]Armor Damage: 8,400 (previously 6,100)[/*][*]Shield Damage: 4,400 (previously 3,800)[/*][*]Charge Time: 0.9 sec (previously 1.2 sec)[/*][*]Reload Time: 4 sec (previously 3 sec)[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b][i]Dev Note:[/i][/b][i] Changes for Noricum didn’t make it into the most recent [/i][url=https://warrobotsfrontiers.com/news/198][i]Balancing Playtest[/i][/url][i], but will be included in the next one. We’re aware of some frustration around this Weapon and are preparing adjustments. Thank you for your patience![/i]
[h3]Gear[/h3][list][*][b]Core Gear: Cold Snap (Siren): [/b]Removed the area of effect (AoE), adjusted the cooldown for various upgrade levels, and reduced the freeze duration.[list][*]Adjusted Cooldowns:[list][*]Level 1: 66 sec (previously 40 sec)[/*][*]Level 5: 57 sec (previously 33 sec)[/*][*]Level 9: 51 sec (previously 28 sec)[/*][*]Level 13: 45 sec (previously 25 sec)[/*][/list][/*][*]Freeze Duration: 5 seconds (previously 6 seconds)[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b][i]Dev Note:[/i][/b][i] The changes were well received during the [/i][url=https://warrobotsfrontiers.com/news/198][i]Balancing Playtest[/i][/url][i], but many players pointed out that the proposed changes for lower upgrade levels caused Cold Snap’s cooldown to be too long. We have reduced the cooldown for lower levels based on the Playtest, but they are still higher than previously on live.[/i]
[h3]Pilot Talents[/h3][list][*][b]Bio Repair:[/b] Armor Restoration changed to 4,000 per sec (previously 2,000 per sec).[/*][*][b]Bullet-Catcher:[/b] Armor Bonus changed to 8% (previously 6%).[/*][*][b]Deflector Gizmo:[/b] Damage Reflected changed to 15% (previously 30%). Decreased the Damage Return value to 15% (previously 30%). Added a 7-second cooldown between each activation.[list][*][b][i]Dev Note:[/i][/b][i] We’re preparing more mechanical changes for Deflector Gizmo, but they require additional testing and will appear in future patches.[/i][/*][/list][/*][/list][list][*][b]Field Repairs:[/b] Armor Restoration changed to 4,000 (previously 2,000).[/*][*][b]Fuel Thief: [/b]Instantly replenishes 5 Fuel when triggered.[/*][*][b]Gear Resonator: [/b]Damage Resistance changed to 7% (previously 4%).[/*][*][b]Maximizer: [/b]Damage changed to 100,000 (previously 200,000).[/*][*][b]Press the Attack:[/b] Fire rate boost is 15% for 7 seconds (previously 30%)[/*][*][b]Prizefighter: [/b]Armor Restoration changed to 7,500 Armor (previously 10,000 Armor). Decreased activation range to 150m (previously 200m).[list][*][b][i]Dev Note:[/i][/b][i] In addition to being highly effective, Prizefighter also turned out to be too versatile, leading us to decrease its activation range.[/i][/*][/list][/*][/list][list][*][b]Quick Reflexes:[/b] Duration changed to 15 sec (previously 5 sec).[/*][*][b]Scavenger:[/b] Ammo Restoration changed to 30% (previously 20%).[/*][*][b]Siege Tower: [/b]Time to stand still changed to 3s (previously 5 sec).[/*][*][b]Trigger-Happy:[/b] Rate of Fire changed to 4% (previously 6%).[/*][*][b]Well-Timed:[/b] Time to stand still changed to 3s (previously 5s).[/*][/list][h2]Bug Fixes[/h2][h3]General[/h3][list][*]Fixed a bug where the camera would spawn below the map when a match starts.[/*][*]Fixed a bug with the Polish localization where acquisition information would overflow on the item card in the Warehouse.[/*][/list][h3]Maps[/h3][list][*][b]Spectrum:[/b] Fixed a bug where the lighting was too bright.[/*][/list][h3]Pilot Talents[/h3][list][*][b]Parasite Protocol:[/b] Fixed an incorrect description. This Pilot Talent does not affect Gear cooldowns.[/*][/list][h3]War Robots[/h3][list][*][b]Typhon:[/b] Fixed a bug where the icons for Typhon Modules showed incorrect colors.[/*][/list][h3]Weapons[/h3][list][*][b]Vortex:[/b] Fixed a bug where the weapon displayed a white box as its icon.[/*][/list]
We’re not stopping here — another Playtest is coming soon, where we’ll showcase even more new balance improvements. notes.title: Hotfix Patch Notes — April 8, 2025
notes.notes:
Attention, Pilots! The following hotfix will be deployed for War Robots: Frontiers following a short period of maintenance on[b] April 8, 2025.[/b]
[h2]Gameplay Adjustments[/h2][h3]Progression[/h3]
[url=https://warrobotsfrontiers.com/news/193]Last week's Hotfix[/url] included an unlisted backend adjustment to expand the range of actions players could perform during Battle to earn Impact Points. While the average number of Impact Points per Battle was expected to remain unchanged, Credits earned during Battle were unintentionally reduced.

To address this issue, this week’s update increases the amount of Credits awarded for certain actions to restore balance and ensure a fair gameplay experience.
[h2]Balancing Adjustments[/h2][h3]Gear[/h3]
[b]Core Gear: Blackout (Typhon)[/b]

We wanted to give players greater control over deciding the optimal moment to fire during combat encounters. As a result, we are adjusting how the lock-on and firing mechanics work for this Core Gear:
[list][*]Homing missiles will [b]no longer automatically fire[/b] upon target lock-on. [/*][*][b]New Mechanic:[/b] When pressing the Gear button, “Blackout” will lock-on to a target. Players need to press the “Fire” button to shoot the homing missiles towards their targeted enemy.[/*][/list][h2]General Improvements[/h2][list][*]The drop-down menu for muting or reporting a player in the Teams Interface now requires only a single click (previously required 2 clicks).[/*][*]Players are now shown a “Press T to Toggle Zoom” hint when switching aiming modes when aiming down right. The hint is displayed below the crosshair.[/*][*]Added a timer in the player HUD (bottom left next to Robot Health) that displays the remaining time of the 2X Damage Power-Up during Team Deathmatch.[/*][*]Improved overall performance and stability of the game.[/*][/list][h2]Technical Improvements[/h2][list][*]Improved overall performance and stability of the game.[/*][/list][h2]Bug Fixes[/h2][list][*]Fixed a bug where double the amount of acquired Experience was shown in the Battle Pass section of the Post Combat interface.[/*][*]Fixed a bug where names were occasionally not displayed in the Leaderboard.[/*][*]Fixed a bug in the Leaderboard where the name was not updated when a player changed their name.[/*][*]Fixed a bug where “Ghost Turret” would not be deployed where the player intended.[/*][*]Fixed a bug where “Ghost Turret” would occasionally not shoot at enemies.[/*][*]Fixed a bug where a debug sphere could become visible to the player when using Core Gear: Napalm Shell (Harpy).[/*][*]Fixed a bug where all projectiles would launch to the same place when using the Core Gear: Steel Feathers (Raven). The projectiles will now correctly fly to the location the player is actively aiming towards.[/*][*]Fixed a bug where the timers for Stickers and Paints in the Store did not display the correct end time.[/*][/list]

Items on sale are not exclusive and may appear again in the future.[/*][*]We are adding Kate Sinclair to the Store for 12,000 Credits, players can purchase a maximum of 1 Hero Pilot per periodic rotation. As mentioned in our latest [url=https://warrobotsfrontiers.com/news/190]Developer Update[/url], in a future update we will also be adding Kate Sinclair along with other Hero Pilots to the Common Pilot rotation at a cost of 8,000 Credits.[/*][*]We are adding the Griffin War Robot to the Store for 16,000 Credits, players can purchase a maximum of 1 War Robot per periodic rotation.[/*][/list]
[h2]General Improvements[/h2][list][*]Improved the visual clarity by adding an orange arrow on Modules that can be upgraded in the “Tuning” and “Building” interfaces.[/*][*]Added a visual cue in the Main Menu which showcases the Mute function.[/*][*]Added a new “Customization” tab in the Store to easily find Customization content.[/*][*]Added a visualisation to showcase the maximum number of Levels available to be acquired in the current Battle Pass.[/*][*]Improved the visual clarity when selecting a War Robot on the War Robot Selection Screen when entering a match.[/*][/list][h2]Technical Improvements[/h2][list][*]Applied some adjustments to improve stability and performance.[/*][/list][h2]Bug Fixes[/h2][list][*]Fixed a bug where Aim Assist and Controller Settings would remain active when changing from a Gamepad to Mouse and Keyboard.[/*][*]Fixed a bug where the camera shake (triggered by Flashbang) would be cancelled by the recoil effect.[/*][*]Fixed a bug where players could get awarded for the same quest twice under specific circumstances.[/*][*]Fixed a bug where Premium Jobs could remain locked when a player has Premium Account.[/*][*]Fixed a bug where weekly quests were updating less often than once per week.[/*][*]Fixed a bug where some parameters related to Impact Points would not be counted in the final Impact Points for a match.[/*][*]Fixed a bug where Noricum (Weapon) would not aim at the enemy when using the “Strong” Aim Assistance setting.[/*][/list]
Follow the game on [url=https://twitter.com/WRFrontiers]X[/url] and [url=https://www.facebook.com/wrfrontiers]Facebook[/url] and join the [url=https://warrobotsfrontiers.com/l/discord]official Discord server[/url] to get all the latest hotfix info.

notes.title: Developer Update: Past, Present, and Future
notes.notes:
First things first—thank you so much for making the release of War Robots: Frontiers successful! We value your feedback above all else, and to that end, we have a developer update for you straight from the War Robots: Frontiers team. 

We want to let you know what we’ve been doing to improve your experience, what’s coming next, and our plans for future content updates. This covers everything from the Store to Leagues, customization, matchmaking, and more. 

While there are many things we’d love to bring to the game, this requires a significant amount of development time and we cannot promise the exact date on which these changes or new features will be implemented. However, we will continue to communicate with you every step of the way!

[b][img]https://static-eu.prod-my.games/chronos-public-eu-wrf-prod/site/2025/03/190-DevDiary/1.png[/img][/b]
[h2]Balancing[/h2]
We understand that balancing is very important to our players, and we’ve heard your concerns. We are aiming to host [b]a playtest in April[/b] to test specific balance adjustments such as weapon and gear rebalancing before we move them into the live version of the game. This way, we can gather player feedback before releasing new content!
[hr][/hr][h2]Store[/h2][h3]Recent Changes (March Updates & Hotfixes)[/h3]
In March, we made the following changes to the Store based on your feedback:
[list][*][b]Owned Items:[/b] Items in the Store now display how many copies of the corresponding item you have in your Warehouse. This is designed to help you make better decisions about where to spend your in-game currencies. [/*][*][b]Store Banner:[/b] Added a banner to Featured Deals to help new players identify where they can find and obtain War Robot Modules for free. [/*][*][b]New Bundle:[/b] We heard your feedback about the lack of customization bundles in the Store. We have added a bundle containing a Sticker, Paint, and Decal and we will add more bundles soon. [/*][*][b]Hero Pilot Talents:[/b] Added “Pick one Talent per rank” to the Show Talents interface for Hero Pilots. This makes it clearer that only one Talent can be equipped per rank (not three).[/*][/list][h3]Upcoming Changes (April 2)[/h3]
[b]On April 2[/b], the team is planning to apply these changes in a hotfix:
[list][*][b]Factory War Robots for Credits:[/b] Adding Griffin (War Robot) to the Store for Credits (on a rotating basis). Factory War Robot Builds will be available for Credits periodically. This is to address feedback that not enough items were available to buy with Credits, making the Store feel oversaturated with WarpReal items.[/*][*][b]Hero Pilots for Credits[/b]: Adding Kate Sinclair (Hero Pilot) to the Store for Credits (on a rotating basis). Hero Pilots will be available for Credits periodically. This is to address feedback that Hero Pilots were not accessible outside of WarpReal purchases.[/*][*][b]Expanded Customization Range:[/b] We are adding a Customization section to the Store to expand the range of cosmetic items available, with items rotating in and out regularly. This is designed to give you more options and freedom when it comes to styling your War Robot. We would love to hear your feedback regarding different customizations that you would like to see. We will be sharing a survey with you in the coming weeks, but for now, you can share your suggestions on our [url=https://warrobotsfrontiers.com/l/discord]Discord[/url].[/*][/list][h3]Future Changes[/h3][list][*][b]Daily Deals:[/b] Adding a list of content and their probabilities to Daily Deals to provide more information about the items on offer.[/*][*][b]Daily Deals Refresh:[/b] We are working on changing the Daily Deal refresh to allow you to refresh once per day for Credits. We’ve heard players’ feedback surrounding the lack of options when it comes to accruing items for progression during daily gameplay.
 We also are looking into changing the price and design of the refresh with WarpReals to better align the speed of obtaining new Modules for all players. [/*][*][b]Store Accessibility: [/b]We are looking to make the experience for new players more comfortable when using the Store. More details will be shared in upcoming hotfixes.[/*][*][b]Pilots Rotation[/b]: Currently, a new Common Pilot is added daily in the Pilots section of the Store, and obtainable via Credits. In order to maximize the possibility of hiring Hero Pilots, Hero Pilots will be added to this rotation pool (also for Credits). [/*][/list]
[b][img]https://static-eu.prod-my.games/chronos-public-eu-wrf-prod/site/2025/03/190-DevDiary/2.png[/img][/b]
[hr][/hr][h2]Leagues & Matchmaking[/h2][h3]Recent Changes[/h3]
We are constantly [b]optimizing matchmaking based on League ranks[/b]. We want to help you match more consistently with players that match your skill level—and we have made recent changes to this effect. 

We have also improved matchmaking by [b]substituting players with bots if they have left the match[/b] in the pre-match interface. 
[h3]Future Changes[/h3]
In [b]Season 1,[/b] players are currently unable to obtain all League Rewards, as some items are removed from the reward list in higher Leagues. 

We have heard feedback from players that they would like the opportunity to earn the rewards they have missed. We have good news: those items will be [b]granted manually at the end of Season 1 [/b](if the milestone was met).

In [b]future Seasons,[/b] we will be working on the following changes:
[list][*][b]Rank-based Rewards:[/b] We are looking at changing the rewards to have them relate to the rank. For example, Emerald-coloured rewards (such as Emerald-coloured Paint) might be awarded in Emerald League Rank. These rewards would be progressive, so players in Gold League Rank would receive the rewards for Bronze, Silver, and Gold sequentially as they rank up (rewards will be distributed at specific milestones throughout the Season). [/*][*][b]Season-exclusive Rewards:[/b] League rewards will be exclusive to Leagues per Season (including Season 1).[/*][*][b]Substituting Quitters for Bots:[/b] We are looking into improving matchmaking further by substituting players with bots if they leave during a Battle. This is complicated to implement—we need to assess how many War Robots a quitting player had left (if any) to not upset the match balance, while not leaving teams at a complete disadvantage. [/*][*][b]Impact Points (Supporting Roles):[/b] We’re looking to add an Impact Point system for supporting combat roles to make playing them feel more rewarding. This will take considerable time to develop, but we will continue to gather feedback on this topic.[/*][/list]
[b][img]https://static-eu.prod-my.games/chronos-public-eu-wrf-prod/site/2025/03/190-DevDiary/3.png[/img][/b]
[hr][/hr][h2]Battle Pass[/h2][h3]Recent Changes (March Updates & Hotfixes)[/h3]
In March, we made the following changes to the Battle Pass based on your feedback:
[list][*][b]Reworked Description:[/b] We reworked the description in the Battle Pass UI to further clarify the difference between Battle Pass and Battle Pass Gold progression.[/*][/list][h3]Future Changes [/h3]
We are clarifying [b]how War Robots (and War Robot Modules) are distributed via active Battle Passes once they have ended[/b], and [b]how to obtain[/b] them in the future. 

For example: Cyclops is currently available in the Under the Wire Battle Pass (Season 1: Blockade) and will be moved into Daily Deals and the Store in the second part of Season 1 when a new Battle pass is active. This will be the case for new War Robots, and they will always follow the following cycle:
[olist][*]A new War Robot enters the Battle Pass.[/*][*]When the Battle Pass ends, the War Robot moves to Daily Deals and the Store.[/*][*]Later on, you will also be able to earn this War Robot through other types of progression.[/*][/olist]
Customization items are not exclusive to the Battle Pass and will be added to offers in the future.

We will continue to optimize the Battle Pass to make earning rewards more satisfying and fun based on your feedback!

[b][img]https://static-eu.prod-my.games/chronos-public-eu-wrf-prod/site/2025/03/190-DevDiary/5.png[/img][/b]
[hr][/hr][h2]Quality of Life[/h2][h3]Recent Changes (March Updates & Hotfixes)[/h3]
In March, the following changes were made to different areas to improve quality of life (QoL) based on your feedback:
[list][*][b]Match Earnings:[/b] We increased the amount of Credits, Experience, and Pilot Experience awarded per match. On average, the amount gained has increased by +50%.[/*][*][b]Premium Rewards:[/b] We resolved issues with Premium Accounts where you didn’t receive the correct rewards or additional Jobs. [/*][*][b]Jobs:[/b] Jobs UI has been optimized to help you identify how to earn Credits and Intel, making the rewards visible.[/*][*][b]Crafting:[/b] We added Crafting Levels to Blueprints in the Workshop to make crafting easier to understand for new players.[/*][*][b]Job Timers:[/b] We added a timer showcasing when Daily and Weekly Jobs reset in the Job Board interface to better clarify when Jobs expire and when new Jobs become available.[/*][*][b]Tutorial:[/b] We added Intel to the Tutorial Jobs in the Job Board, which grants 5 Intel per completion to better introduce the concept of Intel to new players.[/*][*][b]Convert to Custom: [/b]The action of converting a War Robot to custom no longer removes the War Robot from the hangar. We implemented this to prevent players from accidentally entering battle with fewer War Robots than they anticipated. [/*][/list][h3]Upcoming Changes (April 2)[/h3]
[b]On April 2[/b], the team is planning to apply these changes in a hotfix:
[list][*][b]Login Event (April 8–April 22): [/b]We’ll run a two-week Login Event where you can compete in one Battle across seven total days (out of 14) to receive a [b]full Mixed War Robot Build.[/b][/*][*][b][b]Jobs: [/b][/b]We are going to be adding an easier Daily Job for players to complete. More details about this will be added in future hotfix patch notes.[/*][/list][h3]Future Changes[/h3]
From [b]Season 2 and beyond[/b] we will be working on the following changes:
[list][*][b]Profile Level rewards:[/b] We will be making Profile level rewards[b] interactive[/b] in the Profile Level screen. Players will be able to select a reward and view its details.[/*][*][b]Tutorial Improvements:[/b] We are going to rework the Tutorial to ease players into the War Robot building feature. While this change is on our radar, it requires thorough testing and development, so we kindly ask for your patience.[/*][*][b]Fullscreen Mode:[/b] We are adding a “Fullscreen” option in Graphic settings in addition to the current “Windowed Fullscreen” and “Windowed” options.[/*][*][b]Workshop:[/b] We've heard your feedback that building and customizing War Robots felt a bit cumbersome, with too many clicks involved. Some areas also lacked the detail you needed. We’re looking at ways to improve this. These changes will include:[list][*]Our original intent for the [b]Factory War Robot system [/b]was to provide a structured, ready-to-use War Robot for new players while still allowing you the freedom to make strategic adjustments to your Builds. However, we’ve heard that the extra “Convert to Custom” step made the process feel too complex. To streamline the experience, we’re making a change: [b]Factory War Robots will be able to be “customized” directly, without the need for a “Convert”. [/b]Instead of going through an extra step, you will be able to modify your Factory War Robot right away. Removing the conversion step will make it quicker and easier to make adjustments, reduce friction and ensure that all players can enjoy customizing their War Robots without confusion.[/*][*][b]Weapons and Gear[/b] will have small videos showing them in action to help you visually understand how to use them.[/*][*][b][b]Components Navigation Tab [/b][/b]will add into List of Modules screen. When you are customizing a component, you can use this navigation to switch between components, for example, when you are customizing a Chassis, you can switch directly to Torso, without having to go back to the previous interface. Improved customizing efficiency.[/*][*]The [b]Pilot interface[/b] will be improved to clearly show Talents. This is designed to improve your understanding of what a specific Pilot can do. [/*][*][b]Filtering and sorting[/b] will include more options to help players find more specific items.[/*][*]Adding a [b]Disassemble button[/b] for Factory War Robots. Right now, there is no way to strip a Factory Build of its components without deleting it. This new change will keep the template but no Modules will be attached. [/*][*]Adding a feature that clearly shows where and [b]how to obtain specific Modules[/b] for War Robot Builds, allowing you to navigate to the location easily.[/*][*]Adding a new [b]Go Back To Editing button[/b], which will appear when a War Robot is about to be removed from the Hangar. This will be a third option along with Save Changes or Revert Changes.[/*][*]Adding an [b]Add To Hangar button[/b] when you finish building a War Robot in the Workshop.[/*][*]We will be [b]shortening Crew codes[/b] so you can more easily invite your friends.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b]Developer Note: [/b]Proposed and upcoming changes are subject to possible delays or cancellations. 

We’d love to hear your feedback on past, present, and future changes in War Robots: Frontiers. Let your voice be heard on [b]Discord [/b]in [b][url=https://discord.com/channels/941368722860417105/1355179160783294707]#feedback-and-ideas[/url][/b]!

notes.title: Hotfix Patch Notes — March 25, 2025
notes.notes:
Attention, Pilots! The following hotfix will be deployed for War Robots: Frontiers following a short period of maintenance on[b] March 25, 2025.[/b]
[h2]General Adjustments[/h2][h3]General [/h3][list][*]Changed the terminology for Pilots: Pilots will now be “assigned” to War Robots, not “installed”.[/*][*]Added a Player ID watermark to all of the main interfaces, making it easier for players to take screenshots with their Player ID and communicate with Customer Support. [/*][/list][h3]Battle Pass[/h3][list][*]Items in the Battle Pass now display how many copies of the corresponding item the player owns in their inventory.[/*][*]Reworked the description in the Battle Pass UI to further clarify the difference between Battle Pass and Battle Pass Gold progression.[/*][/list]
[b]Developer Note: [/b]We received player feedback that the Battle Pass was a bit confusing in regards to how players earn Battle Tokens. We will continue to monitor feedback and will have more details to share regarding future changes in the coming weeks.
[h2]Gameplay Adjustments[/h2][list][*]Tutorial Jobs in the Job Board now grant 5 Intel per completion.[/*][*]Added a refresh timer for Daily and Weekly Jobs in the Job Board and Play tabs.[/*][*]Adjustments made to make team victory more important for players with a League Ranking of Platinum and above. [/*][/list][h3]Matchmaking[/h3][list][*]Players in Bronze will now only match with other Bronze players, and no longer match with Silver.[/*][*]Players in Silver will now only match with other Silver players, and no longer match with Bronze.[/*][*]Gold players and above will now match with each other.[/*][/list]
[b]Developer Notes:[/b]
[list][*]The above adjustment regarding team victory was not fully solved in the last patch, but has now been fully implemented.[/*][*]We are undoing a [url=https://warrobotsfrontiers.com/news/187]previous change[/url] where players from Gold to Platinum would only match together and Emerald to Noachium to ease bot-encounters during higher-ranked experiences.[/*][/list][h2]Balancing Adjustments[/h2][h3]Weapons[/h3]
[b]Noricum[/b]
[list][*]Increased time to reload from 4s to 5s.[/*][/list]
[b]Rampant[/b]
[list][*]Reduced damage to Shields from 2,800 to 1,800.[/*][/list][h2]General Improvements[/h2][list][*]Adjusted the conversion rate for unspent Battle Tokens when a Battle Pass concludes from 10 Credits per Battle Token to 100 Credits per Battle Token.[/*][/list][h2]Bug Fixes[/h2][list][*]Fixed a bug where Crews of 4-6 players matched against bots could get stuck in the initial battle screen.[/*][*]Fixed a bug with the matchmaking algorithm where Crews would count as a singular player when entering into a battle. This would result in Crews of 2+ players matching with solo players, making the matchmaking experience unfair.[/*][*]Fixed a bug in the Workshop and Warehouse where textures were not applied to the 3D models of Supply and Core Gears.[/*][*]Fixed a bug with Alpha’s Deadlight (Core Gear) where it would deal damage beyond the visible VFX of the target area.[/*][*]Fixed a bug where the required XP to reach the next level in the Battle Pass was displayed incorrectly.[/*][*]Fixed multiple bugs on the Terminus where players could get stuck in various places throughout the map.[/*][*]Fixed a bug where new players were not provided their first War Robot, preventing them from going into Training and regular Battles.[/*][/list]
                                                [b][url=https://warrobotsfrontiers.com/subscribe][img]https://static-eu.prod-my.games/chronos-public-eu-wrf-prod/site/Newsletter%20Buttons/Updated/EN.png[/img][/url][/b]
