notes.title: Early Access Development Update
notes.notes:
Hey, I’m Zukata, the Creative Director of War Robots: Frontiers. I’m here to share an important update about War Robots: Frontiers Early Access and Open Beta. 

It’s been a pleasure to welcome you all to the Wild Ten and experience the exciting new universe we’ve been building together. Thanks for taking the time to play and share your feedback!

We want to deliver a great game that new and existing War Robots fans will love, but it’s clear that we first need to set our sights on making War Robots: Frontiers a more polished and complete package in the long term.

This means that War Robots: Frontiers will enter a more heavily-focused phase of development. We will not launch any major content updates in the meantime, but will instead focus on a revitalized, large-scale update for the game that will launch alongside Open Beta. [b]We now plan to launch Open Beta on PC in 2024[/b], with more information about the console version to follow at a later date. The game will remain fully online and playable throughout Early Access. 

You will also notice that communication will be less frequent over the coming months as we focus our efforts on developing the best possible version of War Robots: Frontiers. If you want to hear the latest news, share feedback, or if you need help, you can reach us via the [url=https://discord.com/invite/PDY5mZGrwD]official Discord[/url] or [url=https://support.my.games/wrf_int]MY.GAMES Support[/url]. 

This additional development time will be committed to optimization, polishing, completing planned features, and improving our network infrastructure. Our focus will be on some of the following key points:
[list][*][b]The Hangar: [/b]War Robots: Frontiers aims to offer the best mech builder in a multiplayer game. This will be a game where our Pilots feel at home in their Hangar as they tinker away and build their ultimate Robot. Improvements to the interface are necessary, but other changes are planned too. The goal is to make this feature exciting, intuitive, and ultimately rewarding. [/*][/list][list][*][b]New Player Experience:[/b] Feedback shows us that players are not currently utilizing all systems in a match to their fullest potential, which makes for less satisfying gameplay. While we strive to create deep game systems that reward savvy Pilots, we want to ensure that new players feel comfortable as they start their journeys on the Wild Ten. For that reason, we will improve the new player experience by better introducing core mechanics through a vastly improved tutorial. [/*][/list][list][*][b]Technical Polish:[/b] At the moment, various technical issues are detrimental to the War Robots: Frontiers gameplay experience. We are working to address issues that affect both visuals and audio, as well as crashes. Further optimization of all aspects of the game is naturally part of our ongoing development efforts. [/*][/list]
Thank you for all your fierce support, passion, and patience. We are developing War Robots: Frontiers with our incredible fanbase in mind, and we promise to deliver a worthy new installment in the War Robots series in 2024!

See you on the Wild Ten!
[list][*][u][u]Zukata, Creative Director of War Robots: Frontiers[/u][/u][/*][/list]
[b]FAQ[/b]

[b]When will War Robots: Frontiers launch in Open Beta on PC?[/b]

The PC version of War Robots: Frontiers will launch in Open Beta in 2024. We will announce exact dates and an updated roadmap on the website, Steam, social media, and the official newsletter when the Open Beta is closer to release. If you want to be among the first to know, join the [url=https://discord.com/invite/PDY5mZGrwD]official War Robots: Frontiers Discord[/url]!

[b]Will War Robots: Frontiers be free-to-play in Open Beta?[/b]

Yes, War Robots: Frontiers is designed as a free-to-play experience. All players can play for free starting with Open Beta, with optional microtransactions (including Battle Passes) also available.

[b]Is the console version of War Robots: Frontiers still planned for release?[/b]

Yes, we plan to release War Robots: Frontiers on PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, and Xbox One. We will announce more details about the console version of the game at a later date.

[b]Will servers remain open during Early Access?[/b]

War Robots: Frontiers will remain active and playable via Steam and MGLauncher for existing players and anyone who buys a Pioneer Pack. However, communications on social media channels, the official website, and Steam will be limited, and any updates and hotfixes that may be released during this time will be smaller in scale.

[b]Can I still buy a Pioneer Pack and play in Early Access?[/b]

Yes! There will be fewer updates and communications as we work towards Open Beta. However, Pioneer Packs will remain available for purchase, the servers will remain live, and the game will remain playable.

[b]When will the next Early Access update be released?[/b]

Minor updates and hotfixes will be released periodically, while large-scale content updates (such as Meet the Corpos and Pilots) will only be released starting with the Open Beta launch. For details about new updates and hotfixes, keep an eye on [url=https://discord.com/invite/PDY5mZGrwD]Discord[/url].

[b]What kind of communications can players expect in the meantime, and how can we stay informed about the development progress?[/b]

Communications on the website, Steam, and social media channels will be a little quieter before Open Beta. You can join the [url=https://discord.com/invite/PDY5mZGrwD]official War Robots: Frontiers Discord[/url], where the Community team will be available to answer questions, provide updates, and host regular community events throughout Early Access.

[b]Will any progress wipes be carried out during Early Access and before Open Beta starts?[/b]

Yes, at least one progress wipe is planned before the release of Open Beta so new players can enter the fray on a level playing field with veteran Robot Pilots. Any progress wipes will be announced in advance on Discord, the official website, and Steam. 

If you transfer items to War Robots: Frontiers from your web Inventory and the game undergoes a progress wipe, don’t worry: your items are safely tracked and will be available to transfer again from your Inventory.

[b]Can I request a refund?[/b]

If you would prefer to receive a refund for your Pioneer Pack, contact [url=https://help.steampowered.com/]Steam Support[/url] for any purchases made on Steam or [url=https://support.my.games/wrf_int]MY.GAMES Support[/url] for any purchases made on the official website.

notes.title: Meet the Corpos: Jump Into the New Update!
notes.notes:
[b]Meet the Corpos [/b]in the new update, now live in War Robots: Frontiers! Grab a [b]Pioneer Pack [/b]to enter the fray in [b]Early Access[/b] on PC via Steam and MGLauncher, available from [url=https://wrfrontiers.com/packs]wrfrontiers.com[/url] and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1491000?beta=0]Steam[/url].

[previewyoutube=nr-KqfIX-nw;full][/previewyoutube]

 [h2]NEW FEATURE: SUPPLY LINE[/h2]
Earn rewards as you progress with the[b] Supply Line[/b]! Collect a special currency from battles that you can spend on seasonal rewards, including the newest items, cosmetics, and other goods direct from Corpo warehouses.
[h2]REAP WHAT YOU SOW WITH A NEW TITAN[/h2]
Tear through enemies with [b]Grim[/b]! This aggressive and speedy Titan exchanges durability for damage. It’s equipped with deadly abilities: deploy a [b]Snare [/b]to harpoon nearby enemies and pull them closer, begin a whirlwind attack with [b]Ripper’s [/b]sharp blades, and blink forward using [b]Lanzette[/b], Grim’s teleportation drive.

Two new Pilots are ready to recruit! 
[list][*][b]Sora "Lioness" Sing[/b]: This brave Pilot specializes in explosive weapons and has a wide range of skills that give stat boosts to allies nearby.[/*][*][b]Idy "Lantern" Demorest[/b]: Idy focuses on fuel management and weapon rate of fire.[/*][/list][h2]QUALITY OF LIFE IMPROVEMENTS[/h2][list][*]Item upgrades will now require a new currency called Intel at certain levels. You can get Intel by completing daily and weekly Missions.[/*][*][b]Elimination Game Mode has been updated. [/b][list][*]The central beacon has been removed.[/*][*]At the start of the match, players deploy at two different spots on opposite sides of the map.[/*][*]As the match progresses, two additional deployment areas become available for each team.[/*][/list][/*][*]Updated UI in the Offers menu.[/*][*]Added in-game notifications.[/*][*]Improved reaction for AI bots.[/*][*]Updated visuals on Crash Site and Mont maps.[/*][*]Updated the Hangar scene and added music.[/*][/list]
Check out the [url=http://link]patch notes[/url] for a full list of new features and changes in the Meet The Corpos Update!
[h2]HOW TO PLAY[/h2]
Purchase a Pioneer Pack to join the fight and play War Robots: Frontiers in Early Access, available from [url=https://wrfrontiers.com/packs]wrfrontiers.com[/url] and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1491000?beta=0]Steam[/url].

You can choose from four Packs, with each unlocking Early Access and exclusive bonus content:
[list][*][b]Iron Pack:[/b] Contains Early Access and four (4) Orkans (Weapons).[/*][*][b]Steel Pack:[/b] Contains Early Access, Varangian (War Robot), four (4) Orkans (Weapons), and 300 WarpReals (in-game currency).[/*][*][b]Titanium Pack:[/b] Contains Early Access, Varangian (War Robot), Kate AKA Sparrow (Robot Pilot), four (4) Orkans (Weapons), one (1) legendary-quality Robot Decal, one (1) Premium Battle Pass, 90 days of Premium Status, and 750 WarpReals (in-game currency).[/*][*][b]Platinum Pack:[/b] Contains Early Access, Varangian (War Robot), Kate AKA Sparrow (Robot Pilot), four (4) Orkans (Weapons), one (1) legendary-quality Robot Decal, four (4) Premium Battle Passes, 1 year of Premium Status, and 1,250 WarpReals (in-game currency).[/*][/list]
All players can access basic War Robots to play with in Early Access, regardless of the Pioneer Pack purchased. For more details about Pioneer Packs, check out our [url=https://wrfrontiers.com/en/news/2-pioneer-packs-get-early-access-exclusive-content]dedicated article[/url].
[h2]JOIN THE WAR ROBOTS COMMUNITY![/h2]
Subscribe to the [url=https://wrfrontiers.com/subscribe]official newsletter[/url] to get more of the latest news like this straight to your inbox, follow the game on [url=https://twitter.com/WRFrontiers]Twitter[/url] and [url=https://www.facebook.com/wrfrontiers]Facebook[/url], and join the [url=http://link]official Discord server[/url]. notes.notes:

[previewyoutube=nr-KqfIX-nw;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]NOTE[/b]: The Supply Line you unlock during this update is not the Supply Line listed among your Pioneer Pack rewards! Starting with the Titanium grade, you will receive a Season Pass for free when the game enters Open Beta and Seasons begin.

[b]NEW CONTENT[/b]
[list]	[*]New [b]Titan - Grim[/b]: A fast-moving assassin Titan ideal for hunting down individual targets. The built-in weapon on Grim and its set of abilities both favor close-range fights:	[list]		[*][b]Snare[/b]: Deploy a trapping device that harpoons all enemies in close proximity and starts pulling them in. The enemies can resist the pulling force by moving in the opposite direction, but they will be slowed down. Snare can be deployed on walls as well as on any solid terrain. The tether ropes get destroyed after a short time.[/*]		[*][b]Ripper[/b]: Begin a whirlwind attack using sharp blades on the Titan’s shoulders. Grim keeps repairing its hull at an increased rate while this ability is active.[/*]		[*][b]Lanzette[/b]: Blink forward using Grim’s teleportation drive. All enemy Robots caught in the trajectory of the Blink will receive damage. All enemy Robots within a small radius around the endpoint of the Blink will be pushed aside and slowed down.[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Two new [b]Pilots[/b]:	[list]		[*][b]Sora "Lioness" Sing[/b]: Specializes in explosive weapons and has a wide range of skills that give stat boosts to allies nearby. One of the options on Sora’s skill tree allows you to get as many Honor Points for assisting the kill as for scoring the kill yourself.[/*]		[*][b]Idy "Lantern" Demorest[/b]: Focuses on fuel management and weapon rate of fire. One of the possible builds allows charging Titan faster.[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]NEW FEATURE: SUPPLY LINE[/b]
[list]	[*]The Supply Line offers a seasonal progression track which unlocks unique rewards, including the latest items added to the game. To access the rewards you need to purchase a Season Pass, play battles, and complete special tasks. You can prioritize certain rewards to get them faster.[/*][/list]
[b]IMPORTANT[/b]: The Supply Line featured in this update is a part of our Early Access tests. The Season Passes included in Titanium and Platinum Pioneer Packs will be added to your account later with the start of Open Beta.

[b]PLAYER PROGRESSION[/b]
[list]	[*]Item upgrades will now require a new currency, Intel, at certain levels. You can get Intel by completing daily and weekly Missions. 	[list]		[*]By introducing this mechanic, we want to ensure that Hangar power directly correlates with a player’s experience. A player needs to complete a fair number of Missions and get acquainted with the game before they can acquire a maxed-out Hangar.[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]All items (Robot parts, weapons, ability modules) now have 13 upgradable levels instead of 5.[/*]	[*]Added Daily Deals to the Offers menu.[/*][/list]
[b]GAME MODE UPDATED: ELIMINATION[/b]
[list]	[*]Removed the central beacon. At the start of the match, players deploy at two different spots on opposite sides of the map. As the match progresses, two additional deployment areas become available for each team. These deployment areas are located closer to the center of the map, so the battle becomes more dynamic.[/*]	[*]Your Titan can be deployed at any deployment area when it is fully charged and when the Robot in current use is destroyed.[/*][/list]
[b]QUALITY OF LIFE IMPROVEMENTS[/b]
[list]	[*]Updated UI in the Offers menu.[/*]	[*]Added in-game notifications.[/*]	[*]Improved reaction for AI bots.[/*][/list]
[b]GRAPHICAL IMPROVEMENTS[/b]
[list]	[*]Updated visuals on Crash Site and Mont maps.[/*]	[*]Updated the Hangar scene.[/*][/list]
[b]SOUND IMPROVEMENTS[/b]
[list]	[*]Added music in Hangar.[/*]	[*]Added sounds for Glacial ability on Siren.[/*][/list]
[b]BUGS FIXED[/b]
[list]	[*]Fixed Robots stumbling on low-profile obstacles when using Dash.[/*]	[*]Fixed Singulators (Matriarch) not shooting down enemy projectiles.[/*]	[*]Fixed weapon icons not showing up on F1 heads-up screen when playing Ares.[/*]	[*]Fixed Napalm (Harpy) damage figures displaying in the wrong area when using Blink.[/*]	[*]Fixed kill count HUD in the Elimination mode not adding score.[/*]	[*]Fixed six-player squads not counting as a full team and bringing two additional players into the match.[/*]	[*]Fixed Ghost Turret item description displaying incorrect ability duration.[/*]	[*]Fixed incoming damage direction indicator pointing in the direction of the enemy Robot that deployed the Ghost Turret rather than the Ghost Turret itself.[/*]	[*]Fixed Ghost Turret not dealing damage to armor.[/*]	[*]Fixed repair from Healing Drone (Tyr) adding up when multiple drones are deployed.[/*]	[*]Fixed Orkan ignoring armor and dealing damage directly to the Robot core when hitting a surface close to where the target stands.[/*]	[*]Fixed Infinite Ammo being available from the start of the match and not having a use limit.[/*]	[*]Fixed Shield Dome (Varangian) having a use limit and featuring an incorrectly smaller dome size.[/*]	[*]Fixed Dash propelling the Robot in the direction of its current movement rather than in the direction of the camera/player input.[/*]	[*]Fixed the issue that allowed passing through the gates in Tutorial without destroying the targets.[/*][/list]

notes.notes:
Need a wingman? Head straight into the danger zone in the Pilots Update, now live in War Robots: Frontiers! Grab a [b]Pioneer Pack [/b]to enter the fray in [b]Early Access[/b] on PC via Steam and MGLauncher, available from [url=https://wrfrontiers.com/packs]wrfrontiers.com[/url] and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1491000?beta=0]Steam[/url].

For a full breakdown of everything new in the Pilots Update, check out the [url=https://wrfrontiers.com/news/59]patch notes[/url].

[previewyoutube=ojG5Lt_G7dU;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]NEW FEATURE: PILOTS[/h2]
Pilots are Robot operators that come with unique specializations and skill trees. You can level them up to enjoy bonuses to help get the edge in combat such as extra damage and defense, plus an Ultimate Ability!

When upgrading Pilots via Skill Trees, players can choose between different skill options at each level to create unique Pilot builds. The skills available depends on a Pilot’s Personality and Specialty, with different Pilots opening up to different playstyles.

The first Pilots to join the game are some of the finest mercs in the Wild Ten. Hail their callsigns and win the fight today in War Robots: Frontiers:
[list][*][b]Kate "Sparrow" Sinclair:[/b] A mercenary from Eirene seeking to make her mark in the Wild Ten, Sparrow is equipped with skills focused on damage output and survivability in close-range combat.[/*][*][b]Leonard "Monk" Fitzpatrick:[/b] Monk hails from a line of soldiers who died before their time, but he now seeks to carve a new destiny for himself. He’s equipped with skills that favor positional gameplay and long-range weapons.[/*][*][b]Marcus "Dome" Shedd:[/b] Born to a closed-off planet and never allowed to explore, Marcus now lives for adventure in the Wild Ten. He’s equipped with skills suitable for either close- or mid-range builds.[/*][*][b]Duncan "Thinkfast" Prasad:[/b] What Thinkfast lacks in brawn, he makes up for in near-unrivalled piloting skills in a Robot. Equipped with skills working in synergy with ability modules.[/*][/list]
A recolored model of Monk has been used as a placeholder for both Dome and Thinkfast in this update. In future updates, every legendary Pilot will receive a unique model and voice lines.
[h2]PLAYER PROGRESSION UPDATES[/h2]
Many changes have been made to speed up progression during Early Access. For instance, you can now quickly progress through account levels, more easily afford certain purchases, and unlock recently-added weapons and Robot parts much faster than before.
[h2]QUALITY OF LIFE IMPROVEMENTS[/h2][list][*]Introduced multiple improvements to the Hangar interface.[/*][*]Added network ping indicators to player nicknames in the combat statistics window.[/*][*]Added a speed counter and fuel level indicator to the back of Robot models.[/*][*]Changed the orientation of the fuel level indicator in HUD to vertical and added threshold markers for Dash and Jump.[/*][*]Added warning icon in Hangar to mark Robot builds that cannot be deployed in battle.[/*][*]Updated descriptions for the Glacial and Singulators abilities.[/*][/list][h2]HOW TO PLAY[/h2]
Ready to enter the Wild Ten? Purchase a Pioneer Pack from [url=https://wrfrontiers.com/packs]wrfrontiers.com[/url] or [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1491000?beta=0]Steam[/url] to join the fight and play War Robots: Frontiers in Early Access. You can choose from four Packs, with each unlocking Early Access and exclusive bonus content:
[list][*][b]Iron Pack:[/b] Contains Early Access and four (4) Orkans (Weapons).[/*][*][b]Steel Pack:[/b] Contains Early Access, Varangian (War Robot), four (4) Orkans (Weapons), and 300 WarpReals (in-game currency).[/*][*][b]Titanium Pack:[/b] Contains Early Access, Varangian (War Robot), Kate “Sparrow” Sinclair (Robot Pilot), four (4) Orkans (Weapons), one (1) legendary-quality Robot Decal, one (1) Premium Battle Pass, 90 days of Premium Status, and 750 WarpReals (in-game currency).[/*][*][b]Platinum Pack:[/b] Contains Early Access, Varangian (War Robot), Kate “Sparrow” Sinclair (Robot Pilot), four (4) Orkans (Weapons), one (1) legendary-quality Robot Decal, four (4) Premium Battle Passes, 1 year of Premium Status, and 1,250 WarpReals (in-game currency).[/*][/list]
All players can access basic War Robots to play with in Early Access, regardless of the Pioneer Pack purchased. For more details about Pioneer Packs, check out our [url=https://wrfrontiers.com/en/news/2-pioneer-packs-get-early-access-exclusive-content]dedicated article[/url].
[h2]JOIN THE WAR ROBOTS COMMUNITY![/h2]
Subscribe to the [url=https://wrfrontiers.com/subscribe]official newsletter[/url] to get more of the latest news like this straight to your inbox, follow the game on [url=https://twitter.com/WRFrontiers]Twitter[/url] and [url=https://www.facebook.com/wrfrontiers]Facebook[/url], and join the [url=http://link]official Discord server[/url]. notes.title: OVERDRIVE Update (0.11.1) Patch Notes (April 6, 2023)
notes.notes:
These are the patch notes for the War Robots: Frontiers build available following a period of maintenance on April 6, 2023. Update your game to the latest version and start playing in Early Access!

[previewyoutube=rU3yVlLX_RY;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]NEW CONTENT[/b]
[list][*]Added a new [b]Robot[/b]:[list][*][b]Siren: [/b]This Robot uses its signature ability to take off, hover in the air, and launch a cryogenic missile that applies Freeze to the target. A frozen target can use its weapons and abilities, but cannot move, including turning around. If a target is hit by Siren’s missile while in the air, it will lose momentum and fall to the ground.[/*][/list][/*][*]Added a new [b]Titan[/b]:[list][*][b]Matriarch: [/b]A support Titan that specializes in protecting its allies, Matriarch comes equipped with two shotgun-type weapons, and features outstanding durability, However, this Titan suffers from low movement speed. Check out its three built-in abilities:[list][*][b]Nanite Field[/b]: Deploy a field of nanorobots that give a boost to all friendly targets within range, increasing their movement speed, overall mobility, and durability regeneration rate.[/*][*][b]Singulators[/b]: Unleash several drones in sequence. The drones hover over the Titan and take down enemy projectiles within their range of effect. The drones move vertically, offering increased protection from enemies on higher ground.[/*][*][b]Swarm[/b]: Emit a swarm of drones that follow the Titan’s movements. All enemies within the swarm take periodic AoE damage and suffer from a decreased rate of fire and accuracy.[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]Added two new [b]weapons[/b]:[list][*][b]Quantum:[/b] Fires a shell that splits up into a cluster of smaller shells after traveling for some time. The first shell deals high damage to a single target, and the second phase shells deal AoE damage.[/*][*][b]Sticky Gun:[/b] Throws quiet sticky bombs for a somewhat stealthy attack. The bombs attach to Robots and hard surfaces on the map and detonate after a short delay, dealing AoE damage.[/*][/list][/*][*]Added two new [b]abilities[/b]:[list][*][b]Counterattack:[/b] Allows the Robot to reflect a portion of incoming damage back at the attacker. The reflected damage will be directed at the nearest piece of the enemy armor. Requires charging.[/*][*][b]Ghost Turret:[/b] The Robot throws a detachable turret that sticks to the ground or walls. The turret will fully deploy after a short time and start firing at enemy targets within its range. The turret cannot be targeted, but it has a limited lifespan and will deactivate after some time.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b]PLAYER PROGRESSION[/b]
[list][*]Updated contents of the Store and level rewards.[/*][*]Added account levels up to Level 65. Level rewards above Level 60 contain item blueprints from this update.[/*][*]Increased the Credits cost of all Ability Modules in the Shop.[/*][/list]
[b]NEW FEATURE: UPGRADES[/b]
[list][*]The first iteration of Upgrades includes upgrade levels from 1 to 5 for Robot parts, weapons, and ability modules. Item stats increase linearly. Certain stats (e.g. movement speed on Robot chassis) will not increase in this version of Upgrades. We invite you to try out the feature and leave your feedback on Discord: [url=http://wr.app/FrontiersDiscord]http://wr.app/FrontiersDiscord[/url][/*][/list]
[b]QUALITY OF LIFE IMPROVEMENTS[/b]
[list][*]Added more info to Robot part descriptions.[/*][*]Added new hangar management options in the Constructor window. “Upgrade” and “Change” buttons will now display next to the selected Robot part.[/*][*]Updated the incoming damage indication in the battle HUD. The indication will now change depending on the amount of received damage.[/*][*]The info overlay on “F1” now contains details about equipped weapons.[/*][*]Changed the default button for switching the Central Camera from “ALT” to “Z”.[/*][/list]
[b]GAMEPLAY IMPROVEMENTS[/b]
[list][*]AI Robots now have access to certain abilities: Blink, Deadlight, Electronic Warfare, Emergency Shield, Energy Shield, Force Screen, Fuel Reserve, Healing Drone, Homing Missile, Increase Damage, Nanite Field, Napalm, Orbital Strike, Rainfall, Regenerate Segment, Retribution, Round Table, Speed Boost, Stealth, Transfusion, Turbo Boost, and Unchained.[/*][/list]
[b]GRAPHICAL IMPROVEMENTS[/b]
[list][*]Updated trees on the Crash Site map.[/*][*]Updated model and textures of the Alpha Titan.[/*][*]Removed shadows from info banners in the Tutorial.[/*][*]Added animations for Healing Drone on Tyr.[/*][*]Added animations for Electronic Warfare on Griffin.[/*][*]Updated the Electronic Warfare icon on Griffin.[/*][*]Updated visuals for Battle HUD.[/*][/list]
[b]SOUND IMPROVEMENTS[/b]
[list][*]Updated sounds for the Drill on the Mont map.[/*][*]Updated launch and explosion sounds for Smoke Wall.[/*][*]Added sounds to Main Menu UI and Constructor.[/*][/list]
[b]BALANCE CHANGES[/b]
[list][*]Adjusted damage bonus when multiple Gozers are equipped.[/*][*]Energy shields are no longer indestructible. They now have a pool of Durability which depletes as the shield absorbs damage.[/*][*]Non-chargeable abilities now have a limit on how many times they can be used within one battle.[/*][*]Revamped stats for multiple items.[/*][/list]
[b]BUGS FIXED[/b]
[list][*]Fixed passability issues on both the Crash Site and Mont maps.[/*][*]Fixed issue preventing Rainfall from being used at a long distance.[/*][*]Fixed incoming damage indicator remaining blue despite energy shields being already depleted.[/*][*]Fixed news text displaying incorrectly when selecting a square aspect ratio.[/*][*]Fixed the issue allowing the ‘About Game’ window to be opened from the Shop.[/*][*]Fixed the issue that prevented the selected pilot from being removed after clicking “Cancel Changes” in Constructor.[/*][*]Fixed digit displacement on the Drill structure on the Mont map when the countdown is below ten.[/*][*]Tuned down the outline flicker in Constructor and in Battle.[/*][/list]

notes.title: Dev Diary: Overdrive Update (Coming April 6)
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43190071/5fb991ef28c1d393b6112b360106b618646ab61f.jpg[/img]

The Overdrive Update arrives in War Robots: Frontiers on April 6, and it’s stuffed to the brim with new and exciting content. 

Level up your gear with Upgrades, and spend Alloys to instantly improve your equipment.

Pilot the brand-new Robot Siren and use its sniper and hover abilities to move tactically around the battlefield and set up for the perfect shot. 

Equip your loadout with two new weapons—Swarm and Sticky Gun. Sticky Gun shoots sticky projectiles, Swarm fires cluster bombs, and both are sure to turn the tide of battle in a flash. 

Also arriving with the Overdrive Update are two new abilities—Ghost Turret and Counterattack. Deploy turrets and reflect incoming damage to cause a splash. 

Saving the best for last, another Titan is entering the fray. Welcome the mother of all support Titans—Matriarch!

Get the lowdown on the Overdrive Update in the latest Dev Diary from Zukata, the Creative Director of War Robots: Frontiers.

[previewyoutube=rU3yVlLX_RY;full][/previewyoutube]

Subscribe to our [url=www.youtube.com/channel/UC7xxqQkPAQ7x6wIVEPZus5w]YouTube channel[/url] for more War Robots: Frontiers videos!

notes.title: Jump into the Elimination Update!
notes.notes:
Shoot to thrill in the [b]Elimination [/b]update, now live in War Robots: Frontiers! Grab a [b]Pioneer Pack [/b]to enter the fray in [b]Early Access[/b] on PC via Steam and MGLauncher, available from [url=https://wrfrontiers.com/packs]wrfrontiers.com[/url] and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1491000?beta=0]Steam[/url].

If you haven’t got a Pioneer Pack, you can try out this update and the full War Robots: Frontiers Early Access experience in an [b]upcoming Free Weekend[/b]. Stay tuned for more details to follow.

[previewyoutube=w-Oluqt5jfA;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]NEW MODE: ELIMINATION[/h2]
The namesake of the new update is the combat-focused [b]Elimination Mode[/b]—a full-throttle fight to the end. The team that has the most Robots left by the end of the match wins!

You can learn more about the mode in the dedicated article [url=https://wrfrontiers.com/news/38]here[/url].
[h2]PILOT NEW ROBOTS[/h2]
Add two new Robots to your Hangar armed with unique skills sure to set the battlefield alight:
[list][*][b]Fenrir: [/b]Named after Odin’s bane, this Robot is just as deadly.Sacrifice half of Fenrir’s durability to gain increased speed and ferocity, and take advantage of its “repair vampirism” to restore both durability and armor for a percentage of damage dealt to enemies.[/*][*][b]Harpy: [/b]A harpy is the mythological personification of storm winds, and this Robot rages just as fiercely. Set fire to your foes with Harpy’s signature ability to ignite targets and deal damage over time.[/*][/list][h2]POWER UP WITH NEW WEAPONS & ABILITIES[/h2]
Boost your battle power with new weapons and abilities:

[b]Weapons:[/b]
[list][*][b]Fowler:[/b] Soup up these shotguns for improved bullet spread.[/*][*][b]Lighter: [/b]Burn up your enemies with ferocious flame throwers.[/*][/list]
[b]Abilities:[/b]
[list][*][b][b]Blast Wave: [/b]Fling foes back and deal damage.[/b][/*][*][b]Dazzle: [/b]Disrupt targeting systems and make aiming impossible for your opponent..[/*][/list][h2]NEW FEATURES: SQUADS AND SMART PING[/h2]
Rally six players to assemble a Squad by sharing Squad Codes for a whole new way to play. You can find teammates and share your Squad Codes on the official War Robots: Frontiers [url=http://wr.app/FrontiersDiscord]Discord[/url].

Additionally, you can now communicate your every move with the Smart Ping system! Activate the ping wheel and coordinate your actions with your team, from attacking to defending to calling out enemies.
[h2]QUALITY OF LIFE IMPROVEMENTS[/h2]
The Elimination update also comes well-equipped with QOL improvements, including:
[list][*]Updated content and level rewards in the Store.[/*][*]Updated translations in all available languages.[/*][*]Alpha Robots have been renamed ‘Titans’. ‘Alpha’ will be the name of the first Titan available to the player.[/*][*]Updated action tips and descriptions in the Tutorial.[/*][*]Increased Smart Ping visibility distance.[/*][*]Improved accuracy for beacon pings.[/*][*]Updated UI in Hangar and on the Matchmaking screen.[/*][*]Replaced the Unequip option in Constructor with an empty slot selection for Chassis, Torso, Shoulders, Weapons, and Abilities.[/*][*]Reduced kill camera duration from 10s to 5s.[/*][*]Further reduced the performance toll of Instant Reload and Infinite Ammo abilities and their visual effects.[/*][/list]

notes.title: ELIMINATION Update (0.11) Patch Notes (March 2, 2023)
notes.notes:
These are the patch notes for the War Robots: Frontiers build available following a period of maintenance on March 2, 2023. Update your game to the latest version and start playing in Early Access!

[previewyoutube=w-Oluqt5jfA;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]NEW CONTENT[/b]
[list][*]Added two new [b]Robots[/b]:[list][*][b]Fenrir: [/b]Builds with Fenrir torsos can sacrifice half of their current durability to gain increased speed as well as “repair vampirism” that will restore both durability and armor for a percentage of damage dealt. [/*][*][b]Harpy:[/b] Its signature ability features a new mechanic, allowing your robot to ignite targets and deal damage over time following each successful hit. It also inflicts a burning area effect on the map that sets enemy robots on fire.[/*][/list][/*][/list][list][*]Added two new [b]weapons[/b]:[list][*][b]Fowler:[/b] Shotguns that gain improved bullet spread when charged by holding down the ‘Fire’ button.[/*][*][b]Lighter:[/b] Flamethrowers that inflict a burn effect on the target as well as the map in addition to dealing direct damage.[/*][/list][/*][/list][list][*]Added two new [b]abilities[/b]:[list][*][b]Blast Wave:[/b] Flings enemy robots back from the target area while also dealing limited damage.[/*][*][b]Dazzle:[/b] Disrupts the targeting systems of the enemy robot, making aiming impossible for your opponent for several seconds.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b]PLAYER PROGRESSION[/b]
[list][*]Updated contents of the Store and level rewards.[/*][*]Added account levels up to Level 60. Level rewards above Level 50 contain item blueprints from this update.[/*][/list]
[b]NEW FEATURE: SQUADS[/b]
[list][*]The first iteration of Squads allows the formation of teams of up to six players by sharing Squad Codes. The player who creates the Squad can share the code outside of the game. Other players can join by entering the code in the Squad window on their end. A Squad can include players from different platforms. Find teammates and share your Squad Codes on the official War Robots: Frontiers Discord: [url=http://wr.app/FrontiersDiscord]http://wr.app/FrontiersDiscord[/url][/*][/list]
[b]NEW FEATURE: PING WHEEL[/b]
[list][*]By default, the ping wheel can be activated by pressing the center mouse button (or mouse wheel). It contains a number of preset communication options for coordinating actions within teams.[/*][/list]
[b]NEW GAME MODE: ELIMINATION[/b]
[list][*]In the combat-focused Elimination Mode, the team that has the most robots left by the end of the match wins. A match can end early if a team loses all its robots. Beacons serve as deployment areas but do not bring any victory points.[/*][/list]
[b]QUALITY OF LIFE IMPROVEMENTS[/b]
[list][*]Updated translations in all available languages.[/*][*]Alpha Robots have been renamed Titans for ease of reference. “Alpha” will be the name of the first Titan available to the player.[/*][*]Updated action tips and descriptions in the Tutorial.[/*][*]Increased Smart Ping visibility distance.[/*][*]Improved accuracy for beacon pings.[/*][*]Updated UI in Hangar and on the Matchmaking screen.[/*][*]Replaced the Unequip option in Constructor with an empty slot selection for Chassis, Torso, Shoulders, Weapons, and Abilities.[/*][*]Reduced kill camera duration from 10s to 5s.[/*][*]Further reduced the performance toll of Instant Reload and Infinite Ammo abilities and their visual effects.[/*][/list]
[b]GAMEPLAY IMPROVEMENTS[/b]
[list][*]Added deployment protection when deploying in home areas. Robots under deployment protection will take significantly less damage. Additionally, in Beacon Rush, Robots will get a bonus to weapon damage for a short time following the home deployment. In Elimination, Robots will get a temporary bonus to movement speed. The bonus does not work when deploying on captured beacons. The deployment protection will make spawn raids a less viable tactic for the opposing teams.[/*][/list]
[b]MAP IMPROVEMENTS[/b]
[list][*]Improved visuals on Crash Site, Mont, and Tutorial maps.[/*][*]Added cooldown indication to the Drill structure on Mont.[/*][*]Added visual feedback when hitting the Drill target areas on Mont.[/*][*]Deployment on beacon “B” on Mont is no longer possible when the Drill is active. This will prevent players from losing Robots instantly upon deployment.[/*][/list]
[b]MOVEMENT AND GRAVITY IMPROVEMENTS[/b]
[list][*]Fixed a number of walking animation bugs. More animation tweaks are scheduled for future updates.[/*][*]Fixed Robots bouncing off of obstacles upon collision.[/*][*]Applied a more advanced formula for calculating walk speed. The speed modifiers are now applied correctly between different chassis types.[/*][*]Adjusted speed modifiers from map terrain. Robots now lose less speed when walking up a steep slope.[/*][*]Adjusted flight dynamics. The new formula better conveys the feel of the size and weight of a Robot.[/*][*]Adjusted central camera position and camera dynamics for a better field of view.[/*][*]Rebalanced fuel consumption of jetpack moves. Robots now consume less fuel in the Jump phase.[/*][*]Significantly improved horizontal controllability in the Flight phase.[/*][*]The dynamics of a Dash now differ to a greater extent between chassis with different base speeds.[/*][/list]
[b]BALANCE CHANGES[/b]
[list][*][b]Railgun[/b]: Charge time reduced from 1.75s to 1s; damage reduced from 5,400 to 3,800 per shot.[/*][*][b]Gozer[/b]: Maximum charge increased from 50 to 60 units; reload time reduced from 4s to 1.5s.[/*][*][b]Shocktrain[/b]: Damage increased from 4,200 to 5,000 per shot.[/*][*][b]Transfusion[/b]: Ability no longer reacts to Scatter projectiles.[/*][/list]
[b]GRAPHICAL IMPROVEMENTS[/b]
[list][*]Updated visual effects for the Flashback ability.[/*][*]Added visual feedback when at full charge on Railgun weapons.[/*][*]Added animations on Punisher weapons.[/*][*]Added animations of torn wire on damaged Robots.[/*][/list]
[b]SOUND IMPROVEMENTS[/b]
[list][*]Added unique sounds for Titan steps.[/*][/list]
[b]BUGS FIXED[/b]
[list][*]Fixed Scatter not registering hits on the Drill target areas on Mont.[/*][*]Fixed Vortex displaying fewer missiles than there are missile slots on the weapon model.[/*][*]Fixed Robot outline flickering excessively in Hangar and during the match.[/*][*]Fixed the Drill dealing damage through the floor on Mont.[/*][*]Fixed the TAB scoreboard being available in the battle results window. If the scoreboard remains open at the end of the match, it will now automatically close as soon as the match concludes.[/*][*]Fixed the issue preventing players from reconnecting into the match after a crash.[/*][*]Fixed the issue preventing certain characters from being displayed in Tutorial descriptions in Turkish.[/*][*]Fixed the last target not dropping when hit in Tutorial.[/*][*]Fixed Sticky Sensor (Titan) sounds not playing on ability use.[/*][*]Fixed Retribution (Ares) laser beams going off on each click of the mouse button, while ignoring the ability timers.[/*][*]Fixed the ammo widget of the first spectated player remaining on the screen when switching to the next player in Spectator mode.[/*][*]Fixed the scroll bar not following the selected pilot in the Pilot menu. Now the selected pilot will always remain on the screen.[/*][*]Fixed Loki displaying incorrect damage indication colors after its decoy hologram is destroyed.[/*][*]Fixed the issue allowing vision through Smoke Wall at certain angles. Now Smoke Wall obscures vision completely.[/*][/list]

notes.title: The Tricksters Update is Live!
notes.notes:
Seize the upper hand with stealth and cunning in the [b]Tricksters [/b]update, now live in War Robots: Frontiers! Grab a [b]Pioneer Pack [/b]to enter the fray in [b]Early Access[/b] on PC via Steam and MGLauncher, available from [url=https://wrfrontiers.com/packs]wrfrontiers.com[/url] and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1491000?beta=0]Steam[/url].

[previewyoutube=3Bd949zO5bE;full][/previewyoutube]

 [h2]EXPAND YOUR ROBOT SQUAD[/h2]
Add two new Robots to your Hangar, and utilise their unique tactics in battle.
[list][*][b]Raven: [/b]Swift and deadly, Raven attacks with a signature ability that fires a volley of deadly projectiles.[/*][*][b]Loki: [/b]Trick your opponents by deploying decoy holograms while also entering Stealth to gain the upper hand. [/*][/list][h2]POWER UP WITH NEW WEAPONS[/h2]
Boost your firepower with three new weapons!
[list][*][b]Scatter:[/b] Launch sonic attacks that can deal damage through solid objects at a certain distance.[/*][*][b]Shocktrain:[/b] Fire precision lasers that deal damage to an extra target nearby after the initial hit.[/*][*][b]Dragoon:[/b] Snipe your unsuspecting enemies with this energy-efficient heavy option.[/*][/list][h2]TURN THE TIDE WITH NEW ABILITIES[/h2]
Switch up the fight with new special abilities!
[list][*][b]Blink:[/b] Instantly dash forward a short distance with lightning-fast speed, enabling you to escape enemy fire, or take the fight to your foe![/*][*][b]Passive Shield:[/b] Fortify your build with this absorbing ability, turning incoming damage into replenishment.[/*][/list][h2]NEW MAP: MONT[/h2]
Enter the fray in a brand-new arena on the new map: Mont! Brush up on our top tips for achieving victory:
[list][*]The beacons near spawn points are easy-to-control, but success lies on the high ground.[/*][*]Attempt to take the hill beacon early, then set up defences. [/*][*]When attacking and enemies are already at the beacon, you can attack the destructible structure to send it crashing down on enemies.[/*][/list][h2]QUALITY OF LIFE IMPROVEMENTS[/h2]
As well as brand-new Robots, Weapons, and Map, the Tricksters update also comes fully stocked with QOL improvements.
[list][*]All available languages now feature updated translations.[/*][*]The Frame Rate Limit is now set to 60 FPS by default, helping to avoid overheating on certain GPUs (this can be adjusted within the game Settings).[/*][*]The Store now features updated content and level rewards.[/*][/list]
Check out the [url=https://wrfrontiers.com/news/31]patch notes[/url] for a full list of new features and changes in the Tricksters Update!
[h2]HOW TO PLAY[/h2]
Purchase a Pioneer Pack to join the fight and play War Robots: Frontiers in Early Access, available from [url=https://wrfrontiers.com/packs]wrfrontiers.com[/url] and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1491000?beta=0]Steam[/url]! 

You can choose from four Packs, with each unlocking Early Access and exclusive bonus content:
[list][*][b]Iron Pack:[/b] Contains Early Access and four (4) Orkans (Weapons).[/*][*][b]Steel Pack:[/b] Contains Early Access, Varangian (War Robot), four (4) Orkans (Weapons), and 300 WarpReals (in-game currency).[/*][*][b]Titanium Pack:[/b] Contains Early Access, Varangian (War Robot), Kate AKA Sparrow (Robot Pilot), four (4) Orkans (Weapons), one (1) legendary-quality Robot Decal, one (1) Premium Battle Pass, 90 days of Premium Status, and 750 WarpReals (in-game currency).[/*][*][b]Platinum Pack:[/b] Contains Early Access, Varangian (War Robot), Kate AKA Sparrow (Robot Pilot), four (4) Orkans (Weapons), one (1) legendary-quality Robot Decal, four (4) Premium Battle Passes, 1 year of Premium Status, and 1,250 WarpReals (in-game currency).[/*][/list]
All players can access basic War Robots to play with in Early Access, regardless of the Pioneer Pack purchased. For more details about Pioneer Packs, check out our [url=https://wrfrontiers.com/en/news/2-pioneer-packs-get-early-access-exclusive-content]dedicated article[/url].
[h2]JOIN THE WAR ROBOTS COMMUNITY![/h2]
Subscribe to the [url=https://wrfrontiers.com/subscribe]official newsletter[/url] to get more of the latest news like this straight to your inbox, follow the game on [url=https://twitter.com/WRFrontiers]Twitter[/url] and [url=https://www.facebook.com/wrfrontiers]Facebook[/url], and join the [url=http://link]official Discord server[/url]. You can also wishlist and follow War Robots: Frontiers on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1491000]Steam[/url] to get the latest news there.

notes.title: Tricksters Update Patch Notes (January 31, 2023)
notes.notes:
These are the patch notes for the version 0.10.2 build available on[b] January 31[/b]. Update your game to the latest version and start playing today in Early Access!

[previewyoutube=3Bd949zO5bE;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]NEW CONTENT[/b]
[list][*]Added two new Robots:[list][*][b]Raven: [/b]Soar and attack with a signature ability that adds extra firepower to your build. Upon activation, it fires a volley of sticky projectiles that glue onto targets and explode after a short while, dealing limited area damage.[/*][*][b]Loki: [/b]Deploy decoy holograms while also entering Stealth. Builds making use of this Robot’s ability often rely on tricking the opponents rather than overcoming them with raw firepower.[/*][/list][/*][/list][list][*]Added three new weapons:[list][*][b]Scatter:[/b] Light slot sonic shotguns that can deal damage through solid objects at a certain distance. [/*][*][b]Shocktrain:[/b] Light slot precision weapons that deal damage to one more target nearby after hitting the initial one. [/*][*][b]Dragoon:[/b] An energy-efficient sniper option for the heavy slot.[/*][/list][/*][/list][list][*]Added new abilities:[list][*][b]Blink:[/b] Instantly transfers your Robot forward a short distance, which can become your prime tactic for escaping enemy fire. [/*][*][b]Passive Shield:[/b] Doesn’t require activation. It absorbs a portion of all incoming damage at the cost of its charge and starts replenishing when your Robot doesn’t take damage for a while.[/*][/list][/*][*]Added a new map: [b]Mont[/b].[/*][/list]
[b]PLAYER PROGRESSION[/b]
[list][*]Updated contents of the Store and level rewards.[/*][*]Added account levels up to Level 40. Level rewards above Level 40 contain item Blueprints from this update.[/*][/list]
[b]QUALITY OF LIFE IMPROVEMENTS[/b]
[list][*]Updated translations in all available languages.[/*][*]The first three matches for newer players will now start instantly upon clicking TO BATTLE. Note that the early matches are played exclusively against AI bots.[/*][*]Frame Rate Limit is now set to 60 FPS by default. This will help avoid overheating on certain GPUs. You can adjust Frame Rate Limit in the game Settings.[/*][*]Reduced performance toll of Instant Reload and Infinite Ammo abilities and their visual effects.[/*][/list]
[b]MAP IMPROVEMENTS[/b]
[list][*]Added the new Mont map to the Beacon Rush game mode. The general matchmaking queue now features two maps: Crash Site and Mont.[/*][*]Updated the Tutorial map.[/*][*]Added a number of visual improvements to the Crash Site map.[/*][*]It is no longer possible to deploy Robots on an ally-controlled beacon if there is at least one enemy Robot contesting the beacon.[/*][/list]
[b]BALANCE CHANGES[/b]
[list][*][b]Shredder[/b]: Damage per shot reduced from 400 to 370.[/*][*][b]Scourge[/b]: Damage per charge increased from 720 to 900 (holds up to 100 charges in total).[/*][*][b]Trebuchet[/b]: Damage per shot reduced from 11,500 to 10,400; Titan and Ultimate Ability charge rate reduced by 15%.[/*][*][b]Gozer[/b]: Damage per charge increased from 100 to 125 (holds up to 50 charges in total); effective range reduced from 500 to 420.[/*][*][b]Pulsar[/b]: Can no longer reload while still firing a burst.[/*][*][b]Deploy Shield[/b]: Dome diameter reduced by 33%. It now becomes more difficult to get under the opponent’s shield, but at the same time, the shield now covers less space.[/*][*][b]Transfusion (Bulwark)[/b]: Will now ignore Halo projectiles, so as to focus on projectiles with higher damage per particle. [/*][/list]
[b]GRAPHICAL IMPROVEMENTS[/b]
[list][*]Added reload animation to Trebuchet.[/*][*]The visual effects of Energy Shield and Infinite Armor Shield are now more transparent.[/*][/list]
[b]BATTLE HUD IMPROVEMENTS[/b]
[list][*]Updated the visuals for incoming damage direction indication. Additionally, hits on your shields will now display in blue.[/*][*]Projectiles that deal no damage (e.g. Typhon’s missiles) will no longer evoke damage reports on target. Prior to this change, their hits would report as “0”.[/*][/list]
[b]BUGS FIXED[/b]
[list][*]Fixed Halo description displaying incorrect damage and effective range in Hangar.[/*][*]Fixed Electronic Warfare (Griffin) being visible through walls and displaying incorrect friend-or-foe colors.[/*][*]Fixed Shield Dome (Varangian) letting through enemy projectiles fired from inside.[/*][*]Fixed Gunsmith skill (Kang Strong) not giving a bonus to kinetic weapons. The skill now correctly affects Tusks, Railguns, Trebuchets, Thunders, Punishers, and Shredders.[/*][*]Fixed progression requirements of Level 40.[/*][*]Fixed replacement Robots deploying at the level entrance in the Tutorial instead of following the checkpoints.[/*][*]Fixed incorrect visual effects displaying for certain Pilot skills. [/*][/list]

notes.title: Update 0.10.1 Patch Notes (December 20, 2022)
notes.notes:
These are the patch notes for the War Robots: Frontiers build available from December 20, 2022. Update your game to the latest version and start playing today in Early Access!

[previewyoutube=mGnNRcDz3i4;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]NEW ITEMS[/b]
[list][*]Added new sets of Robot parts for Typhon and Griffin:[list][*]Typhon’s signature ability targets up to three enemy robots with homing missiles, jamming their weapon systems on hit. Jammed weapons begin reloading instantly and have increased reload times as long as the effect lasts.[/*][*]Griffin is capable of covering itself and its allies in proximity with static noise, making locking on targets impossible for the enemy. This will throw off incoming missiles. Additionally, Griffin distributes all incoming damage evenly between all of its armor segments as long as the ability is active.[/*][/list][/*][/list][list][*]Added new weapons, including Halo, Pulsar, and Gozer:[list][*]All three are light weapons with moderate energy consumption. Halo is ideal for close range, Pulsar is a solid all-rounder, and Gozers work best in a combination of four, serving as a good sniper setup.[/*][/list][/*][/list][list][*]Added new abilities, including Blocking Field and Smoke Wall:[list][*]Blocking Field serves as a deployable cover, creating an impassable wall on the spot of your choice. Smoke Wall allows you to cover the area with thick smoke which renders aimed fire impossible for everyone standing outside.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b]PLAYER PROGRESSION[/b]
[list][*]Updated contents of the Store and level rewards.[/*][/list]
[b]QUALITY OF LIFE IMPROVEMENTS[/b]
[list][*]Added an in-game overlay for quick access to the [url=https://wrfrontiers.com/inventory]Inventory[/url] on the official website.[list][*]You can now transfer items from your Pioneer Pack to your Hangar directly from the game. All future items that will appear in your Inventory on the official website will also be accessible from the Hangar. For more details, check out the [url=http://link]dedicated article[/url].[/*][/list][/*][/list][list][*]Introduced multiple improvements to build management in Hangar.[list][*]You can now save unfinished builds or assemble holographic drafts when some of the required parts are missing. However, you won’t be able to send an unfinished robot to battle.[/*][*]You can now name your robot builds and share them via a web link. You can copy the builds of other players using their links.[/*][/list][/*][/list][list][*]Added Japanese and Chinese in-game localization.[/*][*]Updated localizations for all supported in-game languages.[/*][/list]
[b]IMPROVEMENTS TO AI BOTS[/b]
[list][*]Added matchmaking categories for AI bots.[list][*]Players under Lvl.5 will only encounter AI opponents with drop teams of three robots. Experienced players above Lvl.5 will fight against AI opponents with five robots and an Alpha. Additionally, AI hangars will now feature new builds.[/*][/list][/*][/list][list][*]AI bots can now deploy on captured beacons.[/*][/list]
[b]BALANCE CHANGES[/b]
[list][*][b]Callisto (Alpha):[/b] Magazine size reduced to 45 rounds.[/*][*][b]Zeus:[/b] Damage per shot increased from 10,000 to 13,500.[/*][*][b]Orkan:[/b] Splash damage radius reduced by 33%.[/*][*][b]Homing Missile (Module):[/b] Splash damage reduced by 35%.[/*][*][b]Teleport (Phantom):[/b] The return beacon now expires after 20 seconds. The teleport now activates with a 0.5-second delay.[/*][/list]
[b]BATTLE HUD IMPROVEMENTS[/b]
[list][*]Swapped armor indication for the left and the right shoulder on the tooltip above the target.[list][*]Previously, the tooltip represented armor from the target’s point of view. The bar on the left indicated the status of the right shoulder, and the bar on the right the left. The indication has been swapped to the player’s point of view.[/*][/list][/*][*]Added indication of camera direction on mini-map.[/*][*]Added different colors for the Round Table ability (Lancelot) to differentiate between the friendly and the enemy robot.[/*][/list]
[b]GRAPHICAL IMPROVEMENTS[/b]
[list][*]Updated the model and the animations of the Alpha. (This is not the final version of the Alpha.)[/*][/list]
[b]MAP IMPROVEMENTS[/b]
[list][*]Updated the Tutorial map. (This is not the final version of the map.)[/*][*]Made the cliffs of the waterfall mountain on Crash Site impassable to prevent escaping out of range of most guns.[/*][*]Introduced multiple optimization improvements to Crash Site.[/*][/list]
[b]BUGS FIXED[/b]
[list][*]Fixed incorrect damage numbers appearing in weapon descriptions.[/*][*]Fixed the issue that prevented the LOCKED-ON heads-up from disappearing when being targeted by Homing Pack (Alpha).[/*][*]Fixed the issue that increased shot intervals on Thunder when low on ammo.[/*][*]Fixed the issue that prevented the Repair Drone (Tyr) from being deployed on an inclined or uneven terrain.[/*][*]Fixed the issue that caused the reload indication to start at 20% when the Infiltrator skill is active.[/*][*]Fixed multiple minor interface bugs.[/*][/list]
